"It's okay to cry" After confirming Yeongjae's death, Jeonghu loses it and runs away. Munho does all he could to stop Jeonghu, and promises to make them pay, but Jeonghu doesn't trust him. After hearing his master's final words, Jeonghu hides from the world, and Yeongsin is desperate to find him. Then, a mysterious person comes to her...

"We remember you" Jeonghu wants to be himself when he is with Yeongsin. When Jeonghu comes to him, Munho proposes the fathers' method to Jeonghu  and Munho, Jeonghu and Yeongsin's counterattack begins. However, after receiving Munho's declaration of war, Munsik covertly approaches Yeongsin...

"Back to you" Once Jeonghu begins to investigate his father's case, the team ordered by the Elder begins to take action. Munsik plants seeds of suspicion into Yeongsin, and Munho decides to tell her the truth before Munsik could do it. Yeongsin is in shock when she hears the secret Munho and Jeonghu had been keeping from her. Jeonghu chases the truth about his father in order to go back to Yeongsin, but...

"Will you answer me?" Without having a chance to clear up Yeongsin's misunderstanding, Jeonghu continues investigating what happened to his father. Boss' special team is on Jeonghu's tail to cover up the truth he uncovers. Yeongsin visits Myeonghui to find her truth as well, and ends up seeing Jeonghu there. Those under Munho come together and their operation begins...

"Like ordinary people" The truth of what happened that fateful day is finally exposed, thanks to the tape of Junseok's testimony. Jeonghu decides to stay by Yeongsin's side, and live like ordinary people. The first step of living an average life is meeting his girlfriend's father. However, Munho continues his attack on Boss, who was also exposed along with the truth about Junseok, and Someday falls under attack.

"I'll protect you" Boss uses the same tactic he used on Munsik to own Jeonghu, but Jeonghu bets on himself and leaves Yeongsin to face off against him. Munho and Someday News do not give in to his threats and continue to report on Boss' identity. However, Minja, who has been helping Jeonghu, ends up being tracked by Munsik's cyber team...

"Goodbye, Healer" Boss uses Yeongsin's and Munho's weaknesses to continue threatening them, and Jeonghu feels his limitations in fighting him alone. Minja gathers everyone together, and Munho and Yeongsin prepare a retaliation interview. The day before the big day, Jeonghu prepares a gift for Yeongsin and makes a final decision for the welfare of everyone else.

Mr. Kim is always an accidental hero of good people, but this time he gets kidnapped by thugs by accident as they mistook him as a head of labor union. Meanwhile, the Seoahn Jangryong asks Mr. Kim to be in DF team.

TQ Group takes Mr. Kim in thinking that he is the leader of the Labor Union and makes a deal with him to immediately stop the protest. Mr. Kim has to decide whether he will accept the deal or not. Mr. Kim is also approached by the police for document forgery and they say it's real this time.
Hagyeong and Yooseon help Mr. Kim out of his charges, and Yul gets someone to find out who got him out. Meanwhile, Mr. Kim is sent to the waiting room for ruining the company reputation.

The Crown Prince finds out that Eunuch Hong is actually Hong Gyeongnae's daughter, but he cannot believe she approached him on purpose as a spy. Yeong is heartbroken that he has become the person who only makes life difficult for Raon. He asks Byeongyeon to let him see Raon once more, and Raon meets him just to say goodbye. She pretends as if she became a eunuch on purpose as a rebel so that Yeong would forget about her and not feel apologetic for marrying someone else.

The palace guards capture Hong Gyeongnae alive and prepare for the interrogation. Everyone is shocked to know he is alive, and Raon feels resentful that he didn't even let his family know of his being alive. Meanwhile, Yeong visits Hong Gyeongnae in prison and they discuss the world they dream of.

With Chief Eunuch Han and Byeongyeon's sacrifice, Raon and her father are able to escape from the palace successfully. When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. programmes.st: Mark Hill and Roo Irvine, Day 1
programmes.d: Roo Irvine and a new Road Tripper, Mark Hill, are on the hunt for collectibles around Scotland. Mark buys 1940s ceramics, a ship in a dome and a 1920s French fountain pen while Roo finds some trench art and a piece of Japanese cloisonne.

programmes.st: Mark Hill and Roo Irvine, Day 2
programmes.d: Roo Irvine falls in love with a set of Art Deco-style silver butter knives and gambles on a little penny bank. Mark Hill springs for an Edwardian writing table in incredible condition and is excited about a rare piece of studio glass.

programmes.st: Mark Hill and Roo Irvine, Day 3
programmes.d: In the Scottish Highlands, rookie Road Tripper Mark Hill finds a wooden sculpture of a naked torso, while Roo Irvine picks out silver antiques in almost every shop.

programmes.st: Mark Hill and Roo Irvine, Day 4
programmes.d: Roo Irvine and Mark Hill are as far north on the mainland as they can get! The finds in the Highlands have been great, including some smart whisky glasses and a rare 1950s Bakelite television. Plus, Roo learns about iconic John O'Groats.

programmes.st: Mark Hill and Roo Irvine, Day 5
programmes.d: Roo Irvine purchases a bonbon dish and a pretty Victorian brooch, and Mark Hill goes for glass – he buys a few colorful items, but his gamble on a microscope could be an expensive mistake. Plus a visit to Loch Katrine.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 1
programmes.d: South Wales hosts James Braxton and Izzie Balmer and their 1970s two-seater sports car. Izzie buys a monkey-shaped perfume bottle and an obscure medical curio. James can't resist a bamboo table and a pair of sphinx mounts at a great price.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 2
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer and James Braxton travel through Wales and Shropshire. Izzie springs for an 18th century oak coffer and an 1832 sampler. James has high hopes for 1911 silver scallop shell butter dishes and an Edwardian mahogany table.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 3
programmes.d: In northern Wales, James Braxton buys yet more bamboo, this time in the form of a jardiniere stand. Izzie Balmer picks up a novelty money box shaped like a pigeon, but her biggest purchase is a 19th century tramp art box.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 4
programmes.d: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer hunt for antiques in Snowdonia National Park in Wales, and find scent bottles, brick molds and cloisonne bowls. They also learn about a revolutionary Welsh king and befriend an iconic and "beefy" local.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 5
programmes.d: It's James Braxton and Izzie Balmer's last day in Wales, and Izzie strikes gold, finding a bangle, pendant and earrings. James accumulates a hoard of shiny items – and one piece of silver causes a shock at auction.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 1
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri set off on a northwest antiques hunt in a vintage Jaguar. A 1940s fairground collectible takes bidders for a ride while a silver egg cup has a royal connection.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 2
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri visit Staffordshire, via the Trent and Mersey Canal. Railwayana puts one expert on track for profits while the other hopes a birdcage will fly at auction.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 3
programmes.d: Along the Welsh border, Margie Cooper hopes for big profits from a Victorian oak barrel, while Ochuko Ojiri is stirred by Sheffield silver and is left shaken at auction.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 4
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri head to Worcestershire in their quest for big profits. Margie learns about Victorian kitchen gadgets -- could she make it as a maid? And Ochuko is drawn to a piece of 1970s modern art.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 5
programmes.d: In Wiltshire, Ochuko Ojiri spies a trunk filled with silver and tries to buy the lot, while Margie Cooper purchases an Edwardian shoe sign and an early 20th century mbira. Who will make the most cash at the final auction?

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and David Harper, Day 1
programmes.d: Starting off in Kent in a 1960s Citroean 2CV, it's a feisty reunion in Kent for veteran Road Trippers Catherine Southon and David Harper as they discover that ten years apart hasn't dulled their competitive edge.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and David Harper, Day 2
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and David Harper call on a doggy antique appraiser as they travel along the Sussex coast. David gets into trouble playing cricket in a shop full of china and Catherine hunts for items with an aeronautical theme.

Erin faces off in court against her ex-husband, Jack (Peter Hermann), who is representing the person she is attempting to convict of murder. Also, Danny and Baez investigate to see if the husband is behind the murder of his wife.

After Reggie Wilson (Cyrus Farmer), a witness in a former case of Erin's, asks her for help shutting down a drug operation in his apartment building, she makes it her mission to make the building safe for his family.
Danny and Baez team up with two Russian operatives to search for a dangerous Russian man who entered the U.S. on a diplomatic visa.
When Danny intercepts a shipment of several million dollars that was heading to a drug cartel in Mexico, he becomes a target when they come back for revenge.

After a young girl goes missing, the family argues whether Danny used questionable methods in order to bring her home safely. Meanwhile, Jamie graduates from the police academy and begins his new life as a cop, on the series premiere.
A good Samaritan who takes action against a criminal terrorizing the subway has the Reagans pondering the rights and wrongs of vigilantism.
With a bomb set to detonate in Manhattan, Frank, Danny, and the rest of the NYPD search for its whereabouts. In the midst of the search, the Reagans argue the merits and downfalls of profiling.
Erin's family debates her methods when she uses a law-abiding citizen as bait to take down his gang leader brother.
Erin, Frank, and Danny work together within the system to find justice when a rape case's primary suspect is protected by diplomatic immunity.
Frank mobilizes the entire NYPD to find the killer of an off-duty police officer who was murdered during a diamond heist.
Danny works to discover the source of a deadly narcotic after three teenagers die from a drug overdose.
After witnessing a crime in progress, Jamie's suspect is killed in the pursuit. Danny must solve the case to clear Jamie's name and keep IA from a full-blown investigation.
Three released prison inmates place the Reagan family in danger.
While Danny investigates the murder of a popular nightclub's doorman, Frank gets information that his ex-partner is covering up crimes.
A 25-year-old cold case of Frank's is brought to the forefront when the missing boy's remains are found. Danny and Jackie look into the death of a high-end escort.
Because it involves classified information and a sleeper cell, Frank assigns Danny to cover the shooting of an undercover counter-terrorism agent.
When the son of a Russian gangster is killed at his own engagement party, Danny delves into the world of the Russian mob. Meanwhile, Erin is thrown into a high-profile corruption case.
Hilarious sequel to "Any Friend Of Walter's" in which Obie leaves Walter in Hoss' care.
Hoss and Joe find a woman abandoned by a wagon train because her gift of prophecy is considered a curse.
As payment for a performance in a circus, Joe and Hoss are given an elephant.  They want to keep it but encounter opposition from Adam and Ben.
Moody bounty hunter, Dev Farnum, shows up on the Ponderosa, where the Cartwrights are harboring the wife of the man he is after.
Frank Medford, a figure from Ben's "wild, misspent youth", shows up in Virginia City, and though down on his luck, creates troubles for the Cartwrights by claiming to be a successful businessman.
After a triumphant tour in Europe, a famous Negro singer encounters racial prejudice in Virginia City when he arrives for a concert.
A vain outlaw murders a man in front of witnesses, including Joe, but a clever lawyer is able to get him acquitted.
After their stagecoach crashes, a group of rag-tag passengers and Joe must get out of the desert alive.  One of the passengers may or may not be a murderer and Joe is accused.
Ben must determine who is the rightful heir to a fortune that includes water rights vital to the Ponderosa.
Ben invites opera singer Angela Bergstrom to perform at Virginia City's anniversary celebration.  She accepts, but does not tell him that her famous singing voice is long gone
The Cartwrights play host to Russian royals, who are the target of jewel thieves.
When the woman he was planning to marry is strangled, Joe forces the only suspect to come forward.
A stranger, Bob Jolly, arrives in Virginia City to accuse a drunken Judge Harry Whitaker of sending his innocent father, Carl, to the gallows.
Ben assists Georgio Rossi in his battle for water on adjoining property.
Ben regrets that he helped Tom Slayden start a freight hauling business when Slayden sets out to ruin all the competition, and Joe is shot in the process.

programmes.st: A Hot Day for a Hanging
programmes.d: Hoss is jailed for robbing the bank in Dutchman Flats, a town on the brink of economic collapse, even the sheriff knows he is innocent, but a lynch mob gathers and Hoss' fate is not good.
Joe has a run-in with Calamity Jane, and takes her home with him after promising her dying father to take care of her.
Metal's father, Rock Lee, announces that he will train Metal to master the ultimate taijutsu technique, the Eight Inner Gates.

programmes.st: The Hardest Rock in the World
programmes.d: The first Five Kage Summit since the attack by the Otsutsuki Clan is held in Hidden Leaf. The current Kage as well as their predecessors assemble, except the Third Tsuchikage, Ohnoki.
The ninja assigned to the Hidden Leaf Gate are attacked, and Mitsuki disappears.

programmes.st: The Other Side of the Moon
programmes.d: The village finds out that Boruto and Sarada have gone in search of Mitsuki, and Shikadai and his Team 10 are assigned a tracking mission to bring back them back.
Orochimaru tells Boruto and Sakura about the White Snake Sage who lives in Ryuchi Cave. On their way there, the two are confronted by Team 10.
Boruto and his friends are told they must pass a series of tests in order to meet the White Snake Sage!
The White Snake Sage tells Boruto to bring back the \"Reverse Scale\" from Garaga, a troublesome snake. Boruto and his friends head deeper into Ryuchi Cave and are confronted by a giant serpent.

programmes.st: A Fierce Enemy: Garaga's Ferocious Attack!
programmes.d: Boruto and the others work together to obtain the Reverse Scale from Garaga. But the battle proves difficult, as Garaga has the power to sense the location of its enemies and turn them into stone.
Mitsuki heads toward Kokuyou and Sekiei's homeland, the Land of Earth.
Boruto and his friends manage to overcome Kokuyou, and finally catch with up Mitsuki.
Instead of returning home with Boruto, Mitsuki stays with Kokuyou.
Boruto is injured, unconscious and unable to continue. Everyone thinks about returning to the Hidden Leaf.
The team secretly enters the village determined to find Ohnoki, but they are unaware that they are being watched.
The team finds Ohnoki, but he flatly refuses to help. On top of which, they are attacked and separated.
Boruto and Ohnoki head to the rendezvous point, but they stumble into the Hidden Stone Shinobi Training Grounds
In order to get out of the barrier, Boruto desperately searches for his heart of stone, but he has little success.
Ohnoki takes Boruto to a special location to explain his vision of the future, formed after losing his grandchild, Kozuchi.
Kakou uses a rare and powerful Particle Style and pushes Boruto to the edge.
Boruto and Sarada are caught and taken back to the Hidden Stone headquarters along with Ohnoki.
Kirara appears and turns Boruto and Sarada into "dolls" that must obey her, ordering the two to kill each other.
Shocked and confused by the actions of Mitsuki, Sekiei recklessly attacks him.
Ku appears once again to provoke and attack Boruto.
Boruto and the other Leaf Genin return to the Hidden Leaf with Mitsuki
Boruto and his sister Himawari await Family Day with anticipation.

programmes.st: A Heaping Helping! The Eating Contest!
programmes.d: Boruto comes across an eating contest, held by the popular eateries in the Leaf for Parent and Child Day.

programmes.st: Tactics for Getting Along With Your Daughter
programmes.d: Boruto runs into his teacher Sasuke, who�s returned to the village after a long absence.
Worried that she will become a hindrance to missions, Namida decides to stop crying to prevent the jutsu from accidentally activating.
The Nara clan´s chief elder tells Shikadai to quit being a ninja and become a politician in order to increase the reputation of the clan.
Birds are attacking the residents of a village located on the outskirts of the Land of Fire. Boruto's and Sumire´s teams are assigned a joint mission to identify the cause.
Boruto and Sarada arrive at a certain location to see Jugo, following information gathered from the villagers.
Under Konohamaru´s orders, Sumire and the rest of Team 15 head back to report on the situation, but they are attacked by a mysterious enemy.
Sumire is able to escape with Nue´s help and begins searching for Wasabi and Namida and then Jugo´s friends Suigetsu and Karin suddenly appear.

Sarada and Karin struggle with fighting an enemy who is able to manipulate the power of the Curse Mark at will. Sumire fights alongside Nue to protect everyone, but Nue starts losing control of its powers.

Barbas, the Demon of Fear, returns and tricks Paige into giving him Cole's powers, and plots revenge on the Halliwell sisters by playing them against their darkest fears.
When Phoebe must constantly save the life of her new boyfriend, a warlock shows up from the future, claiming that future Cole sent him in order to kill the boyfriend before Phoebe dies instead.

The Charmed Ones must protect Piper's son from two demons, but the baby has a few surprises of his own. Meanwhile, Paige goes undercover as a bounty hunter and Phoebe's future with the newspaper is threatened by the new owner.

The Charmed Ones face a demon who has been killing leprechauns and stealing their magic. The leprechauns endow the sisters with good luck, which enables Paige to gain material wealth, Phoebe to meet a man, and Piper to book a major star to play P3.

When Piper and Leo begin to have marital problems, Piper casts a spell to allow them to literally see their past together. However, the spell goes awry when Phoebe and Paige are sent back in time to relive Piper's memories.

When a demon attacks and kills one of the three nympths that protect a lake, the Charmed ones try to help. However, once the demon is destroyed, the nypmphs decide Paige should replace the fallen nymph, and they won't take no for an answer.

When Grams comes to the manor for a Wiccan birthing ceremony, for Wyatt, the sisters find out that she has brought a memory from her past, a former lover who wants to kill the Charmed Ones and bring back the love they once shared.

When the mythic Gods, the Titans, are released and kill all the elders, Leo is forced to take over. Meanwhile, a mysterious Whitelighter from the future guides the Charmed Ones when Leo gives the girls the ultimate power to vanquish the Titans.

Maude is shocked and outraged when she receives a series of obscene phone calls, but her biggest shock is yet to come when she discovers who's on the other end.
Everyone gets into the act when Maude recruits her family and friends to sing and dance for a questionable charity telethon on the annual musical.
When a fire breaks out in a restaurant where they are dining, Maude and Vivian escape with only surface bruises, but Walter has to cope with a much deeper psychological scar.
Maude is thunderstruck when the Ethiopian foster child she's supported for 20 years comes to America and turns out to be quite different from what she expected.

programmes.st: A Little Glory, a Little Death
programmes.d: Barnaby investigates the death of a woman who was killed in a car accident after the woman's daughter claims that it was no accident. An aging movie star with something to hide is Barnaby's number one suspect.

Barnaby investigates the theft of a million dollar necklace and the murder of the butler who unwittingly walked in on the thief. The leading suspect is a retired jewel thief with a rock solid alibi-he was on TV at the time of the theft.
Barnaby is one step ahead of three syndicate hit men in tracking down a witness in the remote mountains in a national forest when one of them fires a shot at him, grazing him in the forehead.
Barnaby and J.R. investigates an insurance case that was reported as a suicide, but J.R. has a feeling that it could actually be a murder stemming from a blackmail conspiracy.
One of the girlfriends of a young charmer learns that he has robbed a bank.
In order to stop a psychotic priest killer, Lt. Stone goes undercover as a Roman Catholic priest. The victims were all clergymen who studied at the same seminary.
A cop who finds out that he has a terminal illness sets out to kill a racketeer who's been his quarry for the last year and a half.
An operation run by the syndicate is burgled by a small-time crook.
Lieutenant Stone and Inspector Keller go after two insurance agents involved in the counterfeiting of an 1850 6¢ purple Guyana stamp with a value of $300,000.

McGarrett was tried for murder by dangerous convicts led by enemy Honore Vashon after surrendering for hostages' release. Vashon, seeking revenge, intends to execute McGarrett, but McGarrett has doubt of Vashon's true motives.

McGarrett & hardboiled Dr. Ormsbee clash over top-secret research & defected physicist Chiang Lee seeking asylum in the US. McGarrett is unsure of Ormsbee & Chiang but starts to suspect Chiang of sinister motives.
McGarrett & Five-O protect singer Chelsea Merrimam from assassination by Hawaii kingpin Koko Apaleka, who seeks to eliminate her. McGarrett determined to save Chelsea & nail Apaleka.

Helen Hayes guest stars as Danny's visiting Aunt Clara. The murder of Clara's plane seatmate leads McGarrett to a small band of crooks stealing from abandoned bank accounts, money belonging to Hawaii.

Stabbed critically, a college football star is brought to a hospital by two other stars of the team, instigating a Five-O investigation involving the son of a well-known U.S. Senator and a cold-blooded cover-up of a gang rape.
Five-O's McGarrett framed for possessing stolen art while investigating smuggling ring. Must clear name, find true culprit & solve case. Guest starring Edward Asner.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: After $100,000 goes missing from the bank where he works, Daryl Tyler, a friend of Bubba's, is framed for theft and kills himself. Only his young son knows the truth that could clear his late father's name; however, for now, he won't say a word.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Althea Tibbs finds Lydia Crane, an elderly resident of a local nursing home, wandering along the railroad tracks in the early morning hours. Ms. Crane informs Chief Gillespie that a murder has taken place at the home, and she fears she is next.
MacGyver and Nikki are trapped by old nemesis Murdoc and are forced to flee down the side of a sheer rock formation where an old friend of MacGyver's lost her life.

Steve joins his troubled partner, Reggie Ackroyd, in a rehab facility for stressed-out cops. Reggie seems delusional and keeps blaming a murderer he caught for abducting his wife and daughter, and Steve encourages him.

It's a busy day for the homicide unit and Community General when three murders take place. Further investigation reveals that none of the suspects knew their victims, and they are all terminal patients at Community General.

Jesse and Susan are on their way to Mount Carmel for a romantic getaway weekend but detour to a fishing town when their car breaks down. They grab a bite at the local diner when Susan sees a man she used to know.

When resident Paul Brewer is killed, it's the second murder in a month at the exclusive gated community, Hillview Estates. With no leads on the killer, Steve goes undercover as Dr. Steve Brewer, a community resident.
Sam Coyote, Walker's friend, the Sheriff at the Cherokee reservation has been seeing Nora Shannon, an archaeologist who's been working on the reservation.

Escaped convicts seek shelter in a church while waiting for fake passports and money. One convict has a past relationship with the nuns in church. The nuns, as well as Alex and her women support group, are held captive by the convicts.
CD gets a job as acting Chief of Security at a Resort. When he asks his assistant, Grady what happened to his predecessor, Grady tells him that he had a drinking problem and disappeared.

A woman witnesses a murder and is on the run from the killer. She takes her son to stay with the boy's father who is a pro-wrestler struggling with his own problems. The Rangers try to find the woman to protect her.

A 6-year-old boy is mortally wounded during a late-night shootout in a residential neighborhood between the Rangers and two criminals; Trivette was involved in the shootout when the boy became caught in the crossfire.
When former mobster Jimmy "The Eraser's" new identity is exposed, MacGyver is forced into action to save Jimmy's daughter and grandson.
While hiking through remote wilderness, MacGyver uncovers an elaborate scheme to siphon oil from a pipeline when he comes to the aid of a young girl, terrorized by the legendary Sasquatch.
MacGyver teams up with the sister of a murdered friend to expose a diamond heist operation that they suspect is the work of a diplomat, using his status to shield him from suspicion and arrest.
Working behind the iron curtain to destroy the wreckage of a top-secret jet, MacGyver comes to the aid of a renowned Russian psychic who wishes to defect.
Personal grievances get in the way of detective Harry Trumble's retirement party. Trumble never forgave Dr. Sloan for marrying his college sweetheart and dedicated his life to his work.

Dr. Sloan treats Amanda and Jesse to lunch to acknowledge Amanda's medical examiner investigation award. Unfortunately, their festivities are interrupted when a young man collapses in the hotel restaurant wearing only a bathrobe.
A serial killer is on the loose at Community General, targeting both patients and doctors. Dr. Sloan, Steve, Amanda, and Jesse notice that a murder takes place every hour on the hour.
When Robbie's class harasses a substitute teacher, he gets into a lot of trouble at home.
Mike and Sally argue over the wedding.
Mike and his Air Force Reservist friends collect money for a surgery for a disabled girl.
There's more than their girlfriends at risk if the boys' team loses.
Tramp is scheduled for a film audition in Hollywood.
Mike and Robbie take a song to a New York publicist.
Ernie and Chip reenact "Tom Sawyer."
Steve must take in a delinquent as a houseguest for a week.
Steve has to go to Japan for business and decides to bring the boys along.
Robbie and his friend Hank need money to go on dates, so they decide to start a business for home repairs and outdoor chores.
Dennis starts a rumor that he and his family are moving to New York in order to keep Mr. Wilson in town for an award he is due to receive.
Dennis goes crazy trying to find his gifts.
Dennis meets Whip Crawford, his cowboy idol, after Mrs. Webster tells Dennis that Whip will be in the community pageant.
Mr. Wilson becomes suspicious when he hears noises caused by Dennis and his friends who’ve set up their clubhouse in a crawl space underneath his house.
Mr. Wilson attempts to teach Dennis about bird-watching, and Dennis takes care of a sick bird.
Mr. Wilson purchases a rare coin for $250, but Mrs. Wilson, without realizing what it is, lets Dennis take it to use in a wishing well.

Mike thinks Greg wants to be an architect after reading Greg's school essay, but Greg doesn't want to hurt Mike's feelings and tell him the truth. Meanwhile, the other Brady kids also begin thinking about their future careers.

The kids give Alice the cold shoulder after they think she has broken their trust, so Alice decides to leave her job as housekeeper. However, the kids soon regret the decision after the new housekeeper teaches them a lesson.
Marcia thinks that a girl who is suddenly interested in Greg is actually using him so that Greg will vote for her as head cheerleader--over Marcia.

Peter tries out for the role of George Washington in a school play, but gets the role of Benedict Arnold instead. But he then wants to quit the play altogether when his classmates start branding him as a "traitor."
Marcia has a crush on her new dentist, which only intensifies when she mistakes an opportunity to babysit for him as a date with him to the ballet.

Bobby doesn't want to be safety monitor for his class because his classmates now hate him. However, he soon abuses his power and begins reporting on his family when they break house rules. Meanwhile, the family salvages an old sailboat.
Bobby becomes obsessed with Jesse James. Mike and Carol don't approve of his new hero, and try to find a way to convince him that James was nothing but a "mean, dirty killer."
Marcia breaks a date with Charlie when "big man on campus" Doug Simpson asks her out. However, after she gets hit in the nose with a football, Doug Simpson breaks his date with her.

Peter gets a job at the bike shop, but he is fired after three days. He doesn't want to tell his parents the bad news, because he told the family he might be getting a promotion to salesman the day he got fired.

Cindy loses her mom's earrings after playing with them, and "detective" Peter Brady tries to solve the mystery. But when Carol wants the earrings for a costume ball and they're still not found, the entire family tries to crack the case.
The Brady girls try to play matchmaker between Carol's free-spirited grandmother and stick-in-the-mud Grandpa Brady.

Cindy studies hard and passes a test to appear on a TV quiz show, but an overconfident Bobby does not. But after she passes, he ego goes out of control. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol make plans for a dinner party.
Ellen announces that she was named Raytown's Woman of the Year. At the Banquet, Ellen is having a delightful time, until her family arrives and embarrasses her at the Country Club.
Naomi isn't feeling well, leading Mama to think she is pregnant. The family starts fighting because none of them want to give up their rooms for a new baby.
Naomi, Ellen, and Eunice are in a panic at the hospital because Mama has had an accident. Vint comes and asks what has happened, but each of the women has their own tale about how it happened.

Naomi gets an obscene phone call and doesn't tell the family until the guy calls again. The family unsuccessfully tries to figure out why this guy is after Naomi, blaming her in the process. The family later apologizes.
Ellen has met an attractive, younger man named Glen, but doesn't want Mama to meet him because of the age difference. After the family learns Glen is Ellen's new boyfriend, Mama freaks out.

programmes.t: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programmes.d: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programmes.t: Works for Cello and Piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o
programmes.d: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music.

programmes.t: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programmes.d: Following the life of Clara Schumann, wife of the composer Robert Schumann, revealing her personality from different angles with testimonies from those who knew her, performers of her music and her biographers.
Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programmes.t: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programmes.d: Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Brahms's Symphony No. Four; Antoine Tamestit continues his Artist Portrait.
In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.

programmes.t: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programmes.d: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005).

Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for Best Classical Solo Vocal Album "Crazy Girl Crazy" (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) in 2018 and took home the Grammy for Artist of the Year in 2022.

programmes.t: Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programmes.d: Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt performs with Casco Phil, under the baton of Benjamin Haemhouts.

programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.
Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.

When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August of 1986, residents of Tacoma panic. This is the second young girl killed in five months. Convinced a predator is loose, Police embark on a 32-year inquiry.

This is the story of the hunt for one of the most notorious serial killers in American history--the BTK killer. After committing at least seven brutal murders he vanished for over 25 years before sending clues of his crimes to the media in 2004.

programmes.st: Diary Of A Serial Arsonist/The Lost Clue
programmes.d: A highly-regarded California arson investigator is suspected of setting a series of fires, and in Texas, a man is convicted of raping and murdering his 68-year-old neighbor.

A murderer's saliva, found on envelopes, helps seal his doom 37 years after his first killing. And Colorado police crack a cold case 24 years later when they take a DNA sample from the victim's son that proves that his father murdered his mother.

A detective vows not to shave until he solves the murder of a young Oregon woman. It takes three years and a string of Mexican Mafia informants to crack the case and allow the dedicated detective to shave his beard.
A dry cleaning tag inside a sweatshirt left at a crime scene helps police track down a serial killer and rapist who had been eluding them for years.
In 1984, a 15-year-old girl is found murdered in her grandparents' home. For decades, a stalled investigation only fuels the town rumor mill, pointing an accusing finger at her 13-year-old sister.

We follow Det. Vince Velazquez of Atlanta and Capt. Russell Popham of East Point, Ga., as they work to solve the 1995 rape and murder of 14-year-old Nacole Smith, one of Atlanta's most notorious unsolved crimes.
One family faces two unsolved murders of their loved ones. It takes thirteen years for detectives to uncover the one missing clue that can lead them to the killer: the hidden crime scene.

In this special 100th edition of Cold Case Files, we look at the biggest serial murder case in U.S. history; hunt for the Green River Killer. Dave Reichert, the detective who made finding the killer his obsession, walks us through the case.
The body of Lori Nesson is found in a ditch in 1974, yet her death is not ruled a homicide. After four decades, the cause of death is changed to homicide, and the search begins for a killer.
Our cameras follow Detective Manny Reyes as he investigates the 1990 murder of a Fort Worth, Texas woman. Reyes talks to the woman's two sons, who believe that her husband, Bobby, was the murderer.

In late 1983, the bodies of five people abducted from a local fast food restaurant are found brutally murdered. The main suspect is long believed to be a well-connected local man, until new evidence reveals the true killers.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.
When 18-year-old Shannon Siders' body is found in the woods, everyone in the small town of Newaygo, Michigan, becomes a suspect--but no one is convicted of the crime.
The murder of an Ohio woman in 1974 is solved more than 20 years later after police get a crucial clue--the woman's husband was seen building a coffin-shaped box about the time the woman disappeared.
A Texas woman's murder is finally solved when the killer's plan to kill a second woman and stuff her into a duffel bag goes awry.

Tiffany Haddish, Evan Rachel Wood, Busy Philipps and Mandy Moore pay tribute to the first woman to fight in the Revolutionary War and receive a pension, a museum curator who saved art from the Nazis and Civil War hero Clara Barton.

A lawyer defends the lives of rats in court, Henry Bergh establishes the ASPCA, and horse learns to solve math problems. Featuring Mae Whitman, Claudia O'Doherty, Paul Scheer, Martin Starr and Samm Levine.

Taran Killam, Jerry O'Connell and Bob Odenkirk explore the lives of Jack Parsons, an occultist and rocket scientist; W.C. Minor, the man who helped write the Oxford English Dictionary; and Rasputin, adviser to Tsar Nicholas II.

Abbi Jacobson, Josh Charles, Amber Tamblyn, Jane Krakowski and Jillian Bell salute Margaret Sanger's crusade for accessible birth control, the creation of the Kinsey scale, and Gloria Steinem's undercover work at The Playboy Club.

'Tis the season to learn about history's finest Yuletide stories, from George Washington crossing the Delaware to Charles Dickens's creation of modern-day Christmas, with guest stars Ken Marino, Rob Corddry and Colin Hanks.

Robert E. Lee's estate becomes a burial ground for Union soldiers, counterfeiters attempt to steal Abraham Lincoln's body, and an embalmed bandit makes his way around the country. Featuring Jason Ritter, Justin Long and Jimmy O. Yang.

Questlove, Method Man, Raven-Symone and more celebrate the early history of hip hop, the man known for inventing Motown, Berry Gordy, and "Star Trek" actress Nichelle Nichols's incredible activism on and off the TV screen.

An Italian handyman steals the "Mona Lisa," the "Santa bandits" rob a bank in Texas, and Mossad agents capture a Nazi general in Argentina. Featuring Jack Black, Johnny Knoxville, Tony Hale, "Weird Al" Yankovic and Rachel Bloom.
The dudes become obsessed with betting on high school sports.
Adam and Ders try to become rich inventors, while Blake joins a teenage art collective.
The dudes go on a midnight road trip for the ultimate breakfast burrito.
The guys visit an old folks home and meet Adam's grandfather.
The guys all need a copy of a new video game for very different reasons.
When Alice introduces an automated calling system, Blake imagines a future where the machines have taken over.
The guys befriend Stan Halen, a fraternity brother who promises to initiate them into Kappa Zeta Nu, but his extreme lifestyle may be more than they can handle.
The guys campaign for Jillian to become break room manager so that they can get access to Alice's Costco card, but Jillian quickly turns into a snack tyrant.
After Alice gets mad at Adam, Blake and Ders for trying to have an office fish fry, the guys go in search of a male prostitute to sex her out of her bad mood.
Montez offers to buy the guys tickets to an electronic music festival, but Colleen's baby shower threatens to ruin their good time.
Episode 4 includes Late Night with Butt-Head, Pool Toys, The Final Judgement of Beavis, Right On, and Date Bait, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 5 includes Butt Is It Art?, Figure Drawing, Mr. Anderson's Balls, Teen Talk, and Manners Suck, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 6 includes The Pipe of Doom, Safe Driving, Liar! Liar!, and Generation in Crisis, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 7 includes Beavis and Butt-Head Vs. the Vending Machine, Radio Sweethearts, The Great Cornholio, and Held Back, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 8 includes Choke, Killing Time, Safe House, and Dude, A Reward, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 9 includes Walkathon, Temporary Insanity, Tainted Meat, Dream On, and Beaverly Buttbillies, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
The deputies work as security guards when "CSI: Miami" comes to Reno, and Wiegel and Dangle get a homeless man into a bathtub.
After a drug sting goes wrong, Dangle and Junior race back to the station on foot -- and naked.
Dangle preps for his wedding after his ex-wife's ex-husband proposes, and Wiegel goes into labor while stuck in cake.
The investigation into Sheriff Chechekevitch's murder zeroes in on his ex-wife, and Williams and Wiegel attend a Lamaze class.
Did Dangle and Garcia freeze to death? Did Wiegel's serial killer husband get lethally injected? What is Carrot Top doing in Reno, and why is he so mad?
Spanish Mike Alvarez returns to tempt the deputies, and Jones and Garcia work security at a Ted Nugent concert.
As Williams and Wiegel consider tampering with the vote for deputies' raises, Jones and Garcia tangle with a drug dealer who may be a D.E.A. agent.
While Garcia goes undercover to bust undocumented workers and the people who hire them, Junior spends his day off with his brothers.
When Cartman discovers the Tooth Fairy is paying a premium price for his lost teeth, he and the boys seize the opportunity to make some cash.

A community is left shaken when a dead body is found near a local mosque.
Two law-abiding teens are murdered in a brazen and cowardly attack.
Police fear the worst when a model daughter disappears in Virginia.
Police uncover a twisted tale of friendship and betrayal in Georgia.
A sweet-natured choir girl is found murdered in the Louisiana bayou.
Texas police must untangle a web of betrayal and lies to solve a murder.
A teenager's diary reveals the sordid secret behind her murder in Florida.
An Arkansas community is devastated when a family is found murdered.
A traveling preacher is found in a watery grave on Florida's Gulf Coast.
A beautiful single mother of two goes missing in the backwoods of Florida.
A former prom queen disappears into the murky Florida swamps.
Florida detectives embark on a 12-year manhunt for an elusive suspect.
A small town fears a killer is in its midst after a teen turns up dead.
A murder victim leaves cryptic clues for detectives in North Carolina.
A young woman vanishes after her car breaks down near a Texas swamp.
Racial tensions erupt when a Lakota teen disappears in South Dakota.
Detectives unearth a deadly conspiracy in small town Mississippi.
A night of partying takes a sinister turn for a young woman in Louisiana.
Two women fight to bring a killer to justice in New York.

The BAU goes to Morgan's old neighbourhood in urban Chicago in search of an UnSub targeting middle-aged men, and a clue leads Morgan to believe that they are after someone connected to the man who molested him as a child.
After a father and daughter get kidnapped, a former foe returns with very specific demands.
When an Indianapolis coffee shop is blown up and a hero emerges from the wreckage, the BAU tries to protect that person and his family while searching for the UnSub before more incidents occur.

The BAU helps Rossi's journalist daughter, Joy, investigate the disappearance of a college student. Also, the team is alarmed when Giuseppe Montolo dies in prison after he warns Morgan about the 'Dirty Dozen,' an underground group of hitmen.
When two members of a conspiracy group in Roswell, New Mexico perish in quick succession, the BAU is called to investigate. (TV-14 L, V)

When the BAU investigates incidents of bodies being incorporated into macabre graffiti art in Detroit, they suspect an elusive-yet-notorious street artist could be the UnSub. Dr. Lewis struggles to balance her relationship with her fiancé and her work.
When bodies are discovered in public places throughout Boston, the BAU investigates whether the victims used a taxi or ride-share service before their deaths.
Agent Matt Simmons joins the BAU team in a race to take down Mr. Scratch and save one of their own in the process.
When a series of backyard pool homicides are reported in California, the BAU team team searches for an UnSub with a puzzling past.

Soon after the BAU steps in to help local law enforcement isolate a prime suspect for a ritualistic murder in Tallahassee, Fla., a second person who is related to the first victim is killed under similar circumstances.

When victims are found in Philadelphia in a similar style to victims of The Replicator, the stalker who has been tracking the BAU's every move, the team thinks this could be the break they need to try and apprehend him.

A mother steps forward with valuable information for the BAU to aid in their investigation of an unsub known as the bone crusher. Also, Reid must adapt to a new set of rules in prison life. Tatum O'Neal guest stars. (TV-14 L, V)
The BAU continues its murder investigation in Texas, and clues uncover a deep web of corruption that could be the motive for the killings.
The BAU implements an elaborate strategy to try and take down the 'Dirty Dozen' hitmen ring, with Reid playing a central role. Aubrey Plaza guest stars.
When shooting victims are found in the Los Angeles area with possible links to criminal activity, the BAU searches for a vigilante UnSub.

The BAU team heads to Yakima, Wash., after the remains of a dozen people are found along a creek bed. Also, they welcome new team member Stephen Walker (Damon Gupton), a seasoned profiler from the Behavioral Analysis Program of the FBI.
When the wife of an up-and-coming congressman disappears, the BAU investigates his political enemies as possible suspects.

Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend's wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty's husband, Elias Woodstone (Matt Walsh), tries to ruin it.

When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a friend, and Flower tries to be Pete's basketball buddy.
When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him.

The secret about Trevor's missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone's corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

An '80s "mean girl" ghost named Stephanie (Odessa A'Zion), who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official bed-and-breakfast guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn, and Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.
Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to bring Nigel into his friend group in the second-season premiere.
Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta's death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay's new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah (Drew Tarver). Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try saving an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower's attention.

programmes.st: Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
programmes.d: A séance at Sam and Jay's last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty's past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.
Sam meets a Viking ghost at the Farnsbys' house who has an unexpected connection to Thorfinn. Also, Trevor devises a new method for the ghosts to trade favors.
When a television documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of "Dumb Deaths," Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he died.

Alberta's past expertise comes in handy when Sam and Jay run into complications during their Woodstone whiskey-tasting soiree. Also, Trevor devises a ghost fraternity, which inspires a revelation from Isaac's past.
Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves.

Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Isaac's marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B; however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

Sam gives relationship advice to her and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), ignoring Hetty's warning not to get too close to "the help." Also, Sasappis strikes up a romance with Jessica (Nichole Sakura), the ghost who lives in Freddie's car.

Sam and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), purchases ghost-hunting equipment when suspicious activity leads him to theorize the B&B is haunted. Also, Sasappis risks losing his relationship with Jessica (Nichole Sakura) when Freddie sells his car.
Trevor receives disturbing news about his parents when they come to Woodstone B&B to collect his newly discovered remains. Also, Isaac and Nigel's relationship hits a roadblock.

Lucy decides that the Ricardos need a bigger apartment. She discovers that an older couple in the building just had their daughter move out and they no longer need the extra space. All she needs to do is to convince Ricky to go along with the trade.

An eligible bachelor is in town, and Lucy wants to set him up with a girlfriend of hers. The bachelor is a lingerie salesman by the name of Eddie Grant who is a friend of the Mertzes. Unfortunately, Lucy's attempts at matchmaking fail.
Without consulting Ricky, Lucy buys new living room furniture, using their old set as a down payment. Waiting for the right moment to tell Ricky the news, she hides the new furniture in the kitchen.

Lucy feels that she and Ricky are growing apart because they don't share many of the same interests. To make up for this, Lucy decides to invite herself along to a camping trip that Ricky and Fred are going on.

programmes.st: Ricky and Fred Are TV Fans
programmes.d: Dismayed that they can't seem to unglue their husbands from the boxing match on TV, Lucy and Ethel decided to go out for a bite to eat. However, at the local café they run into a similar problem.

The Ricardos have just purchased a new washing machine and despite their better judgment, agree to sell their old one to the Mertzes. The next day the old machine explodes with water and suds and the Mertzes insist that the deal is off.
Life magazine does a photo layout on the Ricardos and the only part of Lucy visible in the shot is her elbow. Lucy insists on getting a part in Ricky's act so that she can make a name for herself.

After watching two women walk out of a local dress shop with $200 in purchases, Lucy and Ethel decide to buy the shop and go into business for themselves. The first signs of trouble begin when they can't agree on a name for their store.

programmes.st: Lucy and Ethel Buy A Dress
programmes.d: The annual talent show for the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League is going to be televised this year, and Lucy and Ethel are going to perform a duet. Everything is going well as Lucy gets Ricky to emcee the show and help her and Ethel prepare.
treated as if they were men. Later on, when the two couples go out to dinner, Fred and Ricky follow the ladies' instructions.

Ricky's friend Charlie Appleby and his wife Caroline are coming over for dinner at the Ricardos. Charlie is going to have Ricky emcee a TV program he's working on and so Ricky wants to make a good impression at dinner.
Ricky, Fred, and Ethel don't believe that Lucy could go one day without telling a lie. To prove their point, they bet her $100 that within 24 hours she'll be fibbing up a storm.

The Ricardos and Mertzes have a close encounter of the French kind when they go to a bistro and have no clue how to read the menu. Later on, Lucy and Ethel decide to brush up on their French in order to get into the show.
Ethel complains about how shabby her apartment is. She's ashamed of holding a meeting for the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League at her place where women will be donning minks.

It all started with the good intention of getting Fred a new suit for his birthday. Lucy needed to "borrow" an old suit of Fred's for the correct measurements, but there was a witness to her burglary.

Lucy and Ethel are sick of their husbands dressing like slobs when they go out together in the evenings. After one particular outing, the girls get fed up and give their old clothes to a second-hand store.

Lucy gets another shot at being a star when a talent scout for the movies comes to town. Casting for the production agrees to audition Lucy after she gives him an impromptu performance of "There's No Business Like Show Business" with the Mertzes.

A magazine test has gotten Lucy into a tizzy. Lucy and Ricky take a test called "How to Rate Your Marriage." One of the questions in the quiz asks about old flames. When Lucy rattles off a list of old boyfriends, Ricky feels the need to compare.
Out of money, and in need of a million dollar idea, Lucy goes into the business of selling salad dressing. Marketing her salad dressing on TV, Lucy elicits Ethel's help with the advertisement.
Lucy plays the dominant parent role in their son's life. Realizing that he needs to spend more time with his son, Ricky agrees to spend his vacation at home to care for little Ricky.

The Ricardos are hosting an evening with friends. When the last guest to arrive introduces his date—all the men at the party fawn over her. Disgusted by the men's behavior, Lucy and Ethel begin to doubt their own feminine wiles.
Lucy and Ricky's thirteenth anniversary is rapidly approaching. In an outward show of affection, they buy each other gifts—golf clubs for Ricky and fur for Lucy.

The Ricardos are being interviewed for a "day-in-the-life" magazine article on happy married couples. The interviewer arrives at 7 AM just in time to encounter Lucy making breakfast in a frilly lace apron, while Ricky walks in wearing a smoking jacket.

The Mertzes get a pair of new tenants. Sam and Nancy Johnson are from Texas and reportedly have inside knowledge of a certain oil stock that is about to shoot through the roof. Lucy and Ethel are excited by the prospect, but Fred and Ricky have doubts.

How long can Ricky Ricardo go, without losing his temper? When Lucy buys a new hat for $49.50, Ricky goes ballistic. To make a point, Lucy bets Ricky the cost of the hat that he'll lose his temper long before her next purchase.

Hurt that no one seems to care for his home movies, Ricky declares that he will never show them another feature of his...not even the TV pilot he's creating. Jealous of his project, Lucy enables the help of the Mertzes and creates her own musical western.

Ricky scoffs at his wife and Ethel when they adamantly participate in the hunt for the "Bonus Buck" that will win them prize money from a newspaper contest. Later,  Ricky discovers one of the lucky bucks in his own wallet.

Lucy desperately wants to accompany her husband on his concert tour of Hawaii, but Ricky can't afford to bring her along. Unsatisfied, Lucy decides she'll win a trip for herself and neighbors, The Mertzes, by entering a television game show contest.

In an attempt to compete with her wealthy friends, Lucy pledges $500 (that she doesn't have) to charity. Luckily, Ethel spots an ad in Billboard magazine willing to pay $500 to anyone willing to perform a stunt to publicize a new movie, Women From Mars.

Lucy wants to be a published author after hearing about another housewife who made a fortune doing it. Ricky and the Mertzes don't like it when they discover Lucy's book plays too close a resemblance to real life including anecdotes from their own lives.

Lucy organizes an orchestra among her girlfriends, but it plays so horribly that she asks her bandleader husband, Ricky, to come to a rehearsal and give them some advice. His direction does little to help.

Lucy decides to try a new look, despite her husband Ricky's objections. She borrows a black wig from her hairdresser Roberta, who tells Lucy it makes her look like a whole different person. With that in mind, Lucy decides to play a little trick on Ricky.

Ricky becomes interested in a diner that is for sale so the Ricardos and the Mertzes all buy it together. Right away, Ethel and Fred feel they are doing all the work while Lucy and Ricky have all the fun.
Artists from nine of America's best tattoo shops arrive to battle it out for $200,000, the title of Ink Master and the first-ever Master Shop title.
A massive twist shakes up the competition, a painstaking Flash Challenge puts shop relationships to the test, and a tough Elimination Tattoo tests the artists' fundamentals.
A veteran artist returns to take the competition by storm, a difficult Flash Challenge exposes the artists' weaknesses, and the artists tag-team an Elimination Tattoo.
The competition intensifies when the artists are tested on technical application, and two veteran artists make their returns.
Some shops lose their composure during a grueling color realism Elimination Tattoo, and a difficult canvas threatens one shop's spot in the competition.
The competition intensifies as another veteran artist returns, and artists must take on the ultimate test of artistry as they freehand their Elimination Tattoos.
One of the competition's most infamous veterans returns to shake up the game, and the pressure is on when the artists are tasked with a new-school Elimination Tattoo.
An emotional Flash Challenge brings the artists to tears, and the alliance becomes a target when a bulletproof pair of veterans returns to battle it out for the title.
The artists can't find relief in a sculptural Flash Challenge, and in honor of one veteran artist's return, the artists must team up to tackle the infamous pinup tattoo.
The final veteran artist's return sparks an old rivalry, the shops struggle to work together during a woodworking Flash Challenge, and artist Tommy Montoya is a guest judge.
A massive twist in the Elimination Challenge sends the artists reeling, and Four Horsemen tattoos bring the end of days for one pair of artists.
The artists must tackle painful coordinating armpit tattoos, and Chris Nunez and Oliver Peck take charge of doling out canvases to the artists for the Elimination Tattoo.
The six remaining shops must use their sales skills to win over the canvases for the chance to tattoo, and the judges send one more shop packing.
The artists create cohesive designs by painting nude models in the Flash Challenge, and some shops miss the mark on an Asian deity-themed Elimination Tattoo.
The final four shops battle it out in a tattoo marathon for a spot in the finale, a chance at $200,000, and the first-ever title of Master Shop.
In the live finale, the final three shops compete for $200,000 and the first-ever title of Master Shop.
Three of the most skilled Ink Masters return to coach teams of the nation's top tattoo artists for a chance at $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.

programmes.d: On the day of the cultural festival, the dried demons that Kagome brought from feudal Japan are revived. They devour the food that Yuka and the others made.
A demon named Chokyukai is revived, and begins to steal girls. A young man named Kisuke comes to Kaede for help. Inuyasha go to defeat the demon.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 2

programmes.st: Mountain of Demons: Survival of the Duo

programmes.st: The Great Duel at Shoun Falls!

Naraku's baby is bringing virtuous priests close to death and peering into their minds. He is trying to peer into the space between this world and the next.
Naraku's baby was split into two. One half comes back to life in the form of a child dressed in white.
Kanta is an otter demon child. His father's head was taken by Hakudoshi, and he is looking for his father's body.
The area between this world and the next, where Sacred Jewel shard is, is the demon graveyard where Inuyasha's father's corpse rests.

programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang arrive in the land of fire. They discover a giant gateway within a cave in the mountains.

programmes.d: Kagome and the others sense Kikyo's presence from the purifying arrow. Meanwhile, Abihime attacks the village.

Jane is ready to move on from the Marbella and pursue writing full time, but an unexpected development forces her to consider returning to her teaching roots.
Jane's fixation on a negative review has left her with writer's block, so Rogelio suggests she take a class to help.
When Jane, Rogelio and Alba learn what is going on with Xo, they all try to comfort her, but Xo insists they let her live her life.
Xo struggles to make an important decision and looks to Jane for guidance leaving Rogelio feeling like an outsider.
After Jane, Rafael, Petra and JR all go out together, Jane is upset to learn that JR doesn't like her. Jane and Rafael brush off a big relationship moment, but they try to make up for it.
Jane and Rafael find themselves in a not ideal living situation in order to save money.  When Rafael sees Alba try to punish Mateo, an unexpected rift is formed.
Jane believes she and Rafael are in a good place until she realizes he is keeping a secret from her.  Alba's big day has finally arrived, and Jane, Xo and Rogelio are ready to celebrate.

Jane makes a shocking discovery and looks to Rafael for answers, but is confused by his decision to put everything they have on hold. Meanwhile, Petra is trying to secure a future with JR, but her past might jeopardize everything.

With Jane's Catholic guilt starting to settle in, she turns to Alba for advice and gets an unexpected answer. Luisa decides to go see Rose with Rafael by her side, in order to help get answers. Meanwhile, Rogelio is back to work with River.

Jane must get over the newest hurdle in her life, which proves to be harder than she hoped. Rogelio discovers that he and River are not as equal as he thought. Meanwhile, Jane and Petra must deal with the children not getting along.
After talking to everyone else about what is going on in her life, Jane turns to Petra, who she knows will give her a straight answer. In return, Petra leans on Jane for advice about JR.

Jane reluctantly agrees to let Rogelio throw her a big 30th birthday party. Jane's mentor gives her some important advice that may help her start writing again. Meanwhile, Petra thinks she and JR are finally in a good place.

Jane struggles with giving Rafael his space after she discovers that he is hiding a secret. Jane and Michael uncover clues about what happened the day he "died." Petra wants to fit into JR's world and enlists Jane's help.

Jane is trying to go with the flow, so when Michael makes a suggestion that takes her out of her comfort zone, Jane decides to go for it. Jane struggles with her feelings for Raphael while Michael slides back into his old life.

Jane is having a hard time dealing with Rafael avoiding her, so when an issue with Mateo comes up she uses it to get some face time. Rogelio turns to Jane for help when he learns his pilot is in trouble.

When Jane and Rogelio join forces to pitch a pilot, Jane is excited until she discovers a secret about her book being published. Alba and Jorge make an important decision about their future together. Rafael asks Jane to allow Luisa to meet Mateo.
When Rogelio tells Jane that the network wants her to write the script for their telenovela, at first she is excited, but begins to struggle balancing her time between that and her novel.

The children learn all about the piano when they play games, listen to real pianos and even play a little themselves.

After playing with "Stop" and "Go" signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own!  Meanwhile, in the caboose, Barney and the kids enjoy a costume parade, a game of "Musical Stop & Go," and some very vigorous body movement.

It's the day of the bike parade.  But Nick has had a bike accident that leaves his bike in need of repair by Mr. Boyd.  Barney helps Baby Bop and the children learn all about bicycles—and that they are a wonderful way to exercise and have fun.

Barney helps Baby Bop and the children discover big and little things in the world around them.  And by the end of the day, the kids have learned that big or little, they're all wonderful just the way they are!
Barney and the children have fun playing with and learning about busses and cars.
The children bring toys to donate to Mr. Boyd's toy drive.  Baby Bop and BJ arrive and after some convincing, Baby Bop learns about the merits of sharing.
A day of imaginative play and fun for Barney and his young friends is kicked off by the arrival of a variety of boxes from the "Enjoy-Your-Toys Company."  Surprisingly, every box is empty!
Barney and the kids help Baby Bop count to ten by playing games, and visiting a Make-Believe Market.
Nick's homework is to find as many squares as he can.  It's great fun when Barney and the kids help!
Kami, one of Barney's youngest friends, has trouble keeping up with the other kids and she's tired of always being last.  She's not having a very good day.

It's a rainy spring day, and the children can be found inside painting and creating.  Barney arrives, explains the differences amongst the seasons, and suggests playing outside in the rain.  The rain is soon replaced by sunshine and a rainbow.
Every day with Barney is fun—but today is extra special.  It's Barney's birthday!

Tony shares a box full of numbers that he made with his dad.  He is showing them off when a gust of wind blows them all away.  Barney and the kids decide to go on a number hunt.  They soon find Baby Bop and their hunt takes the group all over the park.

Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight!  Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice.  BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.
After a brief misunderstanding, BJ realizes he has many friends.  He enjoys a day playing with Barney and the children.
The children work together to make a bird house.  They are happy to learn that the bird will have lots of company; many animals make their homes in the park too!
The kids have put together a "Caboose Color Collection" which showcases the primary colors—red, yellow and blue.  Barney and Baby Bop enjoy songs and games suggested by the colorful objects.

Barney and the kids help Mr. Boyd prepare his dog Bingo for a trip to the veterinarian for a check, while learning lessons about caring for dogs at the same time.  Meanwhile, BJ is searching for his missing baseball, which he suspects was buried by Bingo.

When Sarah accidentally spills red paint into the blue paint, a mess turns into a perfectly purple day.  The children paint pictures, make purple flowers and plan a purple party for their friend Colleen.

While Barney has fun with his friends every day, there's something special about making a brand NEW friend!  When Mr. Boyd's niece, Colleen visits the park, she's eager to make friends with the other kids...but being the "new kid" isn't easy.
Barney and his friends play hopscotch—with a twist.  Whitney is learning about triangles at school, so Angela created Triangle Hopscotch to help reinforce "triangles."
Through pretend play, Barney, and the children learn about their community and the people that help them live safely and happily there.

The children are invited to a family picnic in the park, but don't know who invited them.  The invitations instruct them to bring a family treasure, so each child has something special with them.  Barney helps lead a discussion about families.
A "too hot" afternoon becomes a "totally cool" day when Barney introduces his friends to the wonders of water.
While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.
Barney helps his young friends find good ways to express and deal with angry emotions.
Mario is trying to write his very own fairy tale.  The children help by acting out some of their favorite fairy tales to give Mario some ideas.

The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise.  Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.

Although the park may be a home away from home for Barney and his friends, BJ wants to build his own "totally awesome, completely cool" house.  While BJ works on his house, Barney and the children learn all about houses and homes.
With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!

When Tony brings his kite to the park to show his friends, it accidentally blows into the branches of a tree!  While waiting for a breeze to blow the kite down, Barney, Baby Bop and the kids play games about "up" and "down."
Barney, Baby Bop and the kids learn all about “on” and “off” by playing games together.
A tea party planned by the children turns into a fun opportunity to reinforce lessons about good manners!  Throughout the day, Baby Bop is given helpful advice.
