The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, both parties seek the 10K court maximum when old friends fight over an RV escalates into a physical assault. Up next, new parents hire an event planner to organize a Sip n' See celebration of their newborn child. The planner backs out when jealousy and threats surface; she is sued for a refund.

Bad blood between unwed parents leads to a fight over a three-year-old car accident and an attempt to collect far more than the car is worth. Jail time, alleged domestic violence and admitted drug use come into play.
In a small Idaho farming community, a teenager sells four piglets to a neighbor and expects to be paid in full. The buyer claims all four animals died and that he owes nothing.

An unlikely friendship develops between a male nurse and a female inmate through a prison pen pal program. Soon after her release, their once-supportive relationship devolves into a fight over stimulus checks and a car loan.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, despite eye-witness testimony, a man insists that his unlicensed girlfriend was not driving his truck when it backed into a neighbor's house. His teenage son backs up his story. Next, a mechanic refuses to return a woman's wrecked car until he is paid; she admits to spending insurance money intended for car repairs on her own personal expenses.
A senior victim of bank fraud seeks restitution from her teenage, great granddaughter who made the mistake of accepting mysterious checks from an ex-con relative.
Teenagers who met in foster care get into a catfight over a boy. Their fight escalates into an aggressive act of caught-on-tape vandalism, an arrest and a 10K lawsuit.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. First, a young woman breaks up with her live-in boyfriend and starts to date their new roommate. The ex-boyfriend sues the happy new couple for $10K and for the return of his two cats. Next, business partners pay $6K to rent a party space for teens; they sue for breach of contract when event restrictions are put in place without their approval.

A man is sued for alleged failure to pay his late mother's caregiver. He accuses the healthcare worker of contributing to the 'delinquency of an elderly patient' by giving his dying mother cigarettes and marijuana.

A 14-year-old girl steals her mother's car, goes on a joyride and T-bones an unsuspecting motorist on her way to work. The teenager runs from the crash site; the injured motorist leaves in an ambulance.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, while attending a friend's birthday party, a teenager accidentally breaks an outdoor sprinkler. Her actions, caught on security footage, cause $9K in flooding throughout an apartment building. In the next case, after inheriting her late brother's home, a woman triples the rent on his remaining tenant and sues him for alleged property damage.
In this two-part episode, a woman who suffered abuse as a child is convinced her neighbor is guilty of neglect and reports her to DCS multiple times.
In part two, the Judge must decide if a woman's allegations are justified as feuding neighbors sue for the 10k court maximum over an alleged assault and shocking charges of child endangerment.

Former army buddies pool their resources to purchase one luxury vehicle in order to start a car rental business. A doomed rental ends with the vehicle being wrecked, their insurance being dropped and thousands in damage.

A young widow with a newborn baby claims her deceased husband’s best friend stole money from his account. The best friend defends his actions passionately and says the money went to a GoFundMe set up for his children.
To make ends meet, young parents decide to sell their pets. They immediately regret their decision and fight for the return of one of their dogs.
To compensate for lost playing time during Covid, a devoted father pays a basketball coach $8500 to start up a team for his son. He sues for damages when the team falls apart.

A man claims he was falsely arrested after a road rage incident in which he was accused of wielding a gun. The victim of his alleged fury submits her frantic 911 call claiming a gunshot can be heard in the background.
A battle of bad online reviews is waged in rural Michigan between a pet daycare business and a water supply company.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, divorcees fight over the fate of $10k in tools: he says she had no right to sell his deceased father's equipment; she says the mortgage had to be paid, and they only sold for $1K. Up next, "Dulce" the Goldendoodle puppy suffers a broken leg while in the care of a new dog sitter who is accused of leaving the pet alone with a child.
Estranged parents fight over their teenager's cell phone, sporting events and a trip to Portugal.

In this two-part episode, a woman does her boss a favor by dropping off lunch to her home only to be attacked by her pit bull the moment she steps through the doorway. The terrifying attack is caught on video.
In part two, after a pit-bull attack, the dog's owner insists that the victim was given fair warning and told not to enter the home.

While riding a scooter together, a man and his son are hit by a truck and thrown to the ground; the father sues the driver for damages but soon finds himself in the hot seat over his handling of the scooter.
After a failed attempt at living together, sisters fight over property damage and the alleged theft of over $14k from their grandmother's inheritance.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a German Shepherd digs under a fence, enters a neighbor's house and kills their baby Macaw. The dog’s owner says they should have had a stronger fence. In the next case, a woman faces an uphill battle trying to collect on a loan from her granddaughter's father. The Judge is appalled by how he treats the woman raising his 12-year-old child.

A youth baseball umpire sues for the $10K court maximum after being violently attacked by a coach whose team was disqualified for fielding illegal players. The umpire's son stepped in to defend his father, only to become the target of an attack by angry parents.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a woman sues a motorist for destroying her parked vehicle in a catastrophic five-car accident. Video reveals the harrowing collision, the near-death of a pedestrian and the car at fault. Next, after the tragic death of her daughter, a grandmother sues her ex daughter-in-law over money raised at a spaghetti fundraiser for her grandchildren.
A 20-year-old with four young children seeks emotional distress compensation when an acquaintance of her incarcerated husband allegedly embarks on a campaign of harassment and defamation.

When a relationship ends, a woman seeks payback of money loaned to help her ex-boyfriend in his custody battle. He countersues, claiming she sent a doctored video to his workplace that got him fired and orchestrated a smear campaign that jeopardized his parental rights.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, after four weeks of dating, a woman is persuaded to invest $10K in a car-flipping venture. She fights to recover her investment when the relationship ends, and the business fails. Next, a man drives cross country to help an entrepreneur sell her beard-care products at a fair. Their collaboration ends in a battle over 78 jars of merchandise.
When jealousy sparks a heated argument between two women vying for the same man, a legal battle ensues, fueled by car vandalism and escalating threats.
A contentious landlord-tenant dispute escalates when two men file dueling restraining orders and sue each other over a security deposit, emotional distress, and harassment.

A jointly-owned vehicle is at the center of the conflict between a man and his current and past girlfriend, both of whom share children with him. Missed payments, insurance lapses, and damages from an accident further complicate the dispute.
In this two-part episode, a disabled veteran turned music entrepreneur sues one of 'Atlanta’s top performers’ for the $10K court maximum.

In part two, a music entrepreneur alleges assault and defamation and considers her partnership with a dancer/singer from Atlanta as the biggest mistake of her life. Their doomed dog-breeding venture comes into play.

A seasoned businesswoman and an animal lover dispute the sale of prized miniature pigs. When one piglet dies in transit, and another succumbs shortly after arrival, the absence of a signed contract complicates their legal battle.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, following an honorable discharge from the military, a teen seeks refuge with her aunt. Months later, she is labeled a ‘burden’ and decides to move out. She sues for belongings left behind. Next, a dog lover is devastated when she entrusts 5 dogs to her groomer but only 4 are returned to her. She is told the dog ‘escaped’ and sues for damages.

In a violent road rage incident, a terrified motorist accuses a driver of deliberately smashing his car window as he attempted to flee the scene after bumping the other car. The defendant claims self-defense, alleging the plaintiff struck him with his car and broke his hand. Both parties submit video footage of the confrontation.

A man seeks $10K in damages for emotional distress after his neighbor's two Cane Corsos injure his German Shepherd. The neighbor claims that the plaintiff's dog started the fight and countersues for $10K, arguing that he was bitten while attempting to separate the dogs.

A concerned aunt sues the owner of a group home for disabled adults after suspicions that her niece was tricked into shoplifting while living there. The landlord claims his son was held hostage by being blocked in the driveway during their move-out process.

During an outing to purchase illegal drugs, a teenager driving his girlfriend’s car is caught in gun crossfire. To evade shots fired, he swerves and crashes the vehicle. His girlfriend reports the car as stolen and seeks $7K in damages to her now bullet-ridden ride.

After losing sight of her unleashed French Bulldog puppy, a woman accuses a neighbor of stealing the animal. Testimony from an animal control officer confirms that the neighbor had the dog on the day it disappeared and that the dog's whereabouts remain unknown.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a man accuses his ex-girlfriend of embezzling several thousand dollars. She claims he intentionally injured her cat, causing the beloved pet to lose an eye. Next, motorcycle enthusiasts accuse a man of stealing their antique Harley Davidson and sue for $10K. The man claims he paid for the cycle in 'shatter' (a marijuana concentrate).

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a mother and daughter face allegations of animal abuse and property damage caused by their two horses, as they sue the stable owner for their security deposit. Next, when a beloved rescue dog goes missing, a neighbor's car gets stuck in the snow while searching for him. A dispute arises over who should bear the cost of the tow truck bill.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, the husband and wife owners of a California production design company make the mistake of overpaying an employee by more than $6000. They seek payback for lost wages and emotional distress. In the second case, longtime golfing buddies dispute the 'negligent' moving of a golf cart that rolled down a driveway and slammed into a BMW.
During her 78-day jail sentence, a woman claims her long-time 'friend' stole thousands from her bank account. He countersues, saying she had him falsely arrested for domestic violence.

An ex-foster youth pursuing a career as a social worker sues her ex-boyfriend's parents after a house fire destroyed her belongings. She contends that the defendants exploited her receipts for insurance reimbursement while they claim she already received compensation through gift cards.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a mother demands payback from her ex-husband for their older son's medical bills and car repairs, claiming he agreed to cover these expenses. He refuses ongoing support for their adult child who lives at home and is employed. Next, a student seeks $10K for pain and suffering, as she dramatically alleges being bitten by her roommate's dog.
Seeking $10K in dental bills, a nanny accuses an au pair of throwing a phone at her face and breaking her front teeth. The au pair suggests she seek dental repair at a more affordable location.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a bride-to-be claims she is the victim of a bait-and-switch when she rents a large bus but a smaller vehicle shows up and ruins her big day. Next, the leader of a support group for gun violence victims sues a fellow member after her ATV is wrecked during an emotional awareness ride. The defendant denies accusations of drunken recklessness.

A woman claims her neighbor's unleashed American Bully dog severely injured her dog, bit her foot, and caused her father to fall in the street. The neighbor insists that her smaller, 13-year-old dog 'Yogi' initiated the aggression.

A woman sues her ex-brother-in-law for damages from a violent street assault, while he countersues with the same allegations. The plaintiff's twin sister serves as a key witness as both parties seek thousands in compensation.

Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a man sues the mother of his child after she allegedly keys his car during a visitation and later assaults him in front of their son. Altercations are captured on video. Next, after her son is sentenced to life in prison, a mother sues his attorney for failing to return expensive clothes she gave her son to wear during the murder trial.
A man alleges that his ex stole money from him while he was incarcerated; she claims that the funds were utilized for shared household expenses. Both parties accuse each other of assault.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a 30-year drywall veteran sues his ex-employee for the remainder owed on a truck and for a gun taken without permission. In the second case, both parties vie for the $10K court maximum as a landlord claims that a contractor, whom he has never met, performed unauthorized renovations and placed a wrongful lien on his property.

A man returns home from a business trip to discover that his girlfriend, whom he relocated from Ohio to Florida with her teen son, has left him for another man. He accuses her of taking his property and of the unauthorized purchase of a $2,200 designer bag.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a woman sues her mobile-home neighbor over the sale of a mobility scooter and alleged harassment. He says that her repeated police reports ultimately led to his eviction. Next, an employer sues his former employee for quitting and failing to work off a sizable advanced payment. The worker claims it was a generous gesture, not a loan.

Following a collision between a woman's car and a 15-year-old boy at an intersection, the driver sues for damages caused to her vehicle and for emotional distress. Dashcam footage reveals the teenager's alleged involvement in a perilous, internet-inspired game of chicken.

Unwed parents sue each other for the $10K court maximum amid claims of assault, vandalism, and infidelity. With a second baby on the way, an alleged marriage-for-citizenship involving a Nigerian family member comes into play.
A man accuses his ex-girlfriend of stealing their pet corgi and breaking their lease. The ex claims she had to move out due to his abusive behavior and insists that the dog is hers.

A blended family sues their landlords after their lease is terminated, triggering a legal dispute involving allegations of harassment, false restraining orders, and property damage. A road rage incident ensues, with the former tenants claiming they were forced off the road and verbally attacked.

Two mothers sue each other for damages following a fight between their 11-year-old girls, who testify in court. The young victim, fearing for her safety, reveals she strategically positioned herself within view of a ring camera, aiming to capture evidence and ensure her mother's protection.
Car enthusiasts clash over an unpaid debt for prized car rims, a failed barter deal, and allegations of aggravated harassment.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, after a brief relationship, a single mom sues her ex for payback of a $5K business loan. He insists they weren’t exclusive and that she knew he spent the money on his mother's funeral. Next, a woman claims the father of her children was violent at her baby shower. She says they were no longer intimate after the incident; he argues otherwise.

A woman sues her former friend, claiming that she only had $100 left to pay off on a car before it was repossessed. Countersuing for an assault, her ex-friend submits evidence of a mutually-violent altercation captured in a live-streaming video.

Two aspiring entrepreneurs from California accuse a man of failing to fulfill their order for custom t-shirts after full payment. The manufacturer claims mislabeled and allegedly 'unsellable' shirt issues are fixable.

Unwed parents battle over the right to claim their child as a tax deduction and contest ownership of shared property. Child protective services intervene to ensure the toddler's best interests are protected.

A driver burdened by parking tickets transfers ownership of his van to an unsuspecting friend to avoid paying fines. When he amasses more ticket violations, she repossesses the vehicle only to have it stolen; he sues for its return.

A man refuses to pay the adoption fee for a sick Labradoodle puppy, claiming that vet bills far outweigh the animal's value. He admits to giving the pup away when the seller did not retrieve it and that he already has 22 other dogs.
In this two-part episode, a woman loses her job after being accused of drugging and assaulting her colleague during an overnight business trip.

In part two, after allegations of gross misconduct on a business trip, co-workers battle for the court's maximum amount. Their dueling defamation charges hinge on conflicting recollections of that night.

A father seeks the court maximum of $10,000 from his 25-year-old son as reimbursement for bail and legal expenses following the son's arrest on Super Bowl Sunday for driving under the influence and carrying concealed weapons.

In part one of this two-part case, a young father sues his ex-fiancée for the $10K court maximum, claiming false assault charges led to a sweeping restraining order preventing him from seeing their children for two years.

In part two, ex-fiancées share conflicting narratives of violence, highlighting a chaotic Valentine's Day dispute that ends a week later with a young mother's hospital visit and competing police reports.

A family disagreement takes a drastic turn when a gun-wielding security-guard brother, citing self-defense, faces charges of domestic violence and assault after an altercation at their ailing grandfather's house.

The Judge rules on two cases. First, a barbershop owner accuses her former employee of breaching a non-compete agreement by launching a rival shop nearby, a mere three months after leaving her employment. Next, in search of discounted dental work, a couple flies to Colombia for a cosmetic procedure. They break up and proceed to fight over who should pay for the cost of their improved smiles.

Amidst an impending marriage, tensions escalate as a woman accuses her future stepdaughter of tire slashing and social media slander. While admitting to carrying a knife for safety, the stepdaughter counters with claims of an eviction, illegal lockout, and theft of her property.

In part one of this two-part case, a pharmacist takes legal action against his neighbor, alleging an unrelenting campaign of harassment involving police reports triggered by accusations of illegal drug use, drug dealing, and violent domestic disputes.
In part two, a longstanding neighbors' feud reaches new heights, leading to court appearances, protective orders, and a barrage of vulgar conduct captured on camera.

Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman sues her former friend for $3,500, claiming the friend's unsupervised 5-year-old son destroyed her decade-old breast implants, stored in a sealed bag in her bedroom. In the second case, a dispute arises in a friends-with-benefits relationship as neighbors clash over a car loan and reimbursement for lost dresses.

Competing lawsuits ignite between a tenant and her landlord, fueled by the loss of subsidized housing, drug accusations, and an eviction. Claims of property damage and accusations of running a puppy farm come into play.

The $10,000 court maximum is at stake as an elderly landlord faces a terrifying arrest due to false accusations of gun possession. His tenants deny claiming that he aimed an AR-15 at them, while the landlord insists it was retaliation for his attempt to evict them.

Former friends sue each other for the $10K court limit, after an altercation at a bar where one woman stabbed the other two. Claims of self-defense and counter-claims of harassment are further complicated by the fact that one defendant is now married to the plaintiff's ex-boyfriend.

A mother seeks payback for wedding expenses from her daughter's ex-fiancé after he ended the engagement. He attributes the failed nuptials to the mother's interference and a contentious prenuptial agreement.

Former partners battle over competing assault allegations and the custody of their two beloved corgis, one of whom makes an appearance and charms the entire courtroom. Concerns about the dogs' welfare arise when the Judge reviews a video of an online challenge where a slice of cheese is thrown on a dog's face.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman sues her ex-partner of 25 years after enduring a forced eviction and alleged abuse in their shared home, which she had lived in since childhood. In the second case, a yoga instructor returns from abroad to discover that the woman who rented her car for three years had a DUI and installed a breathalyzer in the vehicle.

Teenagers fight over an unauthorized 3-minute joy ride that results in a blown engine and sizeable repair bill. Blame shifts to the sports car owner when video evidence of a reckless, high-speed freeway ride is introduced.
In a canine custody battle, a man brings his dog breeder friend to court over Gizmo, a French bulldog. The dispute uncovers ethical concerns about animal welfare in the breeding industry.

In this two-part episode, a woman sues for damages to her car after a heated altercation between her grandson and the defendant. Tensions erupted when the grandson flipped off the defendant for honking at him for walking too slowly across the street.
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.
Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.
A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.
A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.
When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.
A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy

Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

Robin trata de desafiar las leyes de la física con la construcción de una barraca gigantesca.
La mala suerte persigue a la tripulación de Jade City, y todos piensan soluciones distintas.

Robin y Alan comprueban si el jade extraído puede venderse en el mercado chino.
Claudia y su equipo hacen un llamamiento a Steve para que los ayude a salvar la temporada.
La temporada de Jade está a punto de terminar y parece que no van a alcanzar el objetivo.
Las heladas de invierno se están acercando y el equipo aún no ha dado con la veta de jade.
Las máquinas de Claudia y Robin comienzan a averiarse en el brutal trayecto hacia la mina.
La tripulación intenta cruzar ríos crecidos mientras marchan con sus máquinas hacia la mina.
Josh se queda varado en el largo sendero que conduce a la mina de Wolverine.
Guy y R2 luchan para conseguir cualquier gramo de jade y Alan les hace una propuesta.
Guy queda a cargo de Wolverine. Claudia y Robin establecen los objetivos de esta temporada.
Jay sufre un colapso que deja al descubierto las fallas de su preparación para emergencias.
Un arsenal de rocas sin valor impulsa a Claudia a considerar una nueva estrategia minera.
Alan lleva a un grupo de compradores a Jade City y el equipo de Claudia entra en pánico.
Josh corre el riesgo de perder 1 millón de dólares tratando de sacar su camión de un pozo.
El equipo encuentra la mejor roca de jade de la temporada, pero corre el riesgo de socavar su valor.
Justin, el hijo de Claudia, demuestra que tiene olfato para el jade.
Robin y Justin hacen una última búsqueda desesperada para ir a buscar rocas de jade.

La presión para el equipo aumenta: deben encontrar la pieza de jade antes del final de la temporada.

Justin se apresura a reclamar lo que le pertenece, luego de tropezar con un asombroso hallazgo.
Justin y el equipo se distraen intentando mover una gigantesca roca que podría valer una fortuna.

Justin y Mike luchan entre sí tratando de demostrar sus métodos a los impacientes inversores.

El invierno llega a Dynasty y la tripulación lucha por la mía hasta el último minuto posible.

Los aguaceros amenazan la seguridad de la tripulación y cierran la minería en el Pozo 3.
Cuando un importante comprador de jade no queda impresionado con la lente Pozo 3, Claudia se ve obligada a tomar una decisión difícil.
La carrera para preparar el campamento en Wolverine se convierte en una pesadilla.
El brutal viaje a una nueva mina separa a la familia y lleva a Josh al límite.
Claudia está ansiosa por comenzar a construir el nuevo sitio.
Los pequeños lujos en el campamento animan a un equipo descontento y los visitantes sorpresa aumentan las esperanzas de Claudia.
Gary y Josh no regresan de una búsqueda rutinaria de combustible y los núcleos de perforación ponen en duda la calidad de las lentes de jade en 2 Mile.
La tripulación finalmente logra un gran éxito, pero con el invierno acercándose, a Claudia le preocupa que el gran hallazgo haya llegado demasiado tarde.
Claudia está desesperada por comenzar a minar, pero las brutales condiciones del camino la hacen preguntarse si la tripulación logrará llegar a su reclamo.

Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Después de perder dos semanas de minería en los incendios forestales, Claudia y Robin corren el riesgo de regresar a Two Mile y apostar por la apertura de un nuevo pozo.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.

Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.

Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.

Claudia y Robin se apresuran a encontrar una segunda roca de jade antes de que su comprador abandone el trato.
Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.
La tensión surge entre Claudia, Robin y Josh mientras hacen un último intento por cerrar un trato con un comprador de Vietnam.
Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.
Arrastrar una roca de 20 toneladas por el peligroso camino para salir de la mina resulta demasiado para su viejo camión 6-Pack.
Robin descubre una enorme lente de jade en Two Mile, pero podría ser demasiado grande para que su pequeña operación la excave.
Cuando una extraña tormenta de nieve en agosto deja a Claudia y Robin varados en Two Mile, Gary y Garon intentan salvar el día conduciendo a través de la tormenta.
Robin toma una decisión difícil sobre su querido camión minero 6-Pack después de otra costosa avería.
Con el invierno acercándose, Claudia lleva a su exhausto equipo al límite, provocando que los ánimos se caldeen.
La nueva temporada minera está llena de sorpresas desagradables, pero un rescate improbable salva el día.
Harto de trabajar para su padre, Josh inicia su propio negocio de transporte por carretera con un semirremolque nuevo.
El camión del ejército muere en el brutal camino hacia la mina.

programmes.t: From The Scene For The Scene
programmes.d: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.
Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.
A psychiatrist's life is terrorized when a killer begins attacking the women in his life.
A sound-effects man witnesses and records a car accident that turns deadly...for him.

programmes.t: The Adventures Of Priscilla, Queen Of The Desert
programmes.d: A wonderfully inventive Australian comedy about three drag performers braving the vast, rugged outback.
To save her family from a farmer's plow, a mild-mannered mouse has a plan to move her house!
A host of stars voice this delightful animated tale of a dog sent back to Earth from Heaven.
Those lovable mutts Charlie and Itchy return for an all new animated, musical adventure!
To prove himself, Igor, a mad scientist's assistant, creates a sweet, show-tune-singing monster.
A wayward teen finds comfort and friendship with the military dog of his deceased older brother.
Ice Cube headlines a stellar cast this hit comedy about a southside Chicago barbershop.
Calvin (Ice Cube) is struggling to keep his father's shop alive, competing with a name-brand chain next door!
When her egotistical boss pushes her a hair too far, top stylist Gina decides to open her own beauty shop!
Four conniving jewel thieves compete for a fortune in jewels in this outrageously funny farce
A classic comedy about finding your heart...and kidnapping a date for your school reunion!
A former thief and a brash young drifter team up to pull off the perfect heist in this bold crime thriller!
Join Caractacus Potts and his magical, flying automobile for a trip to classic family fun!
This lavish musical is the story of a poor man whose love and faith help him face oppression.
Nicholas Nickleby sets off on an adventure to reunite his broken family in Dickens' beloved novel come to life
Liam Neeson stars as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor.
John Hurt shines as a doomed rebel in this stunning film adaptation of George Orwell's classic novel.

Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.
Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.
An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.
Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.
Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.
The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner, who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles.

programmes.t: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programmes.d: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.
Steve and Terri Irwin set out to save a crocodile, unaware that it’s swallowed a U.S. satellite beacon, and now they’re targets of the CIA! Crikey!

When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!

John Woo directs this epic, action-packed drama about a WW II soldier (Nicolas Cage) assigned to protect a Navajo soldier (Adam Beach)...and the secret code he knows. Christian Slater, Roger Willie, Peter Stormare and Mark Ruffalo also star.

Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?
Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!
Filled with gripping suspense and eye-popping action, this intense thriller is an unrelenting terror-fest that’ll scare the stuffing out of you!

An evil witch is reincarnated, in modern day New York, in the form of a beautiful Vespa riding punkette. To maintain her eternally youthful status, she must sacrifice a virgin and find a sacred ring which holds tremendous powers.
The demented Doctor Blood thinks he can create the “perfect" human from a corpse. But when he needs a live donor, his neighbors begin to vanish!

programmes.t: The Monster That Challenged The World
programmes.d: The beaches go from fun-filled swim-fests to horrifying slug-fests when gargantuan vampire snails threaten to suck the life out of all mankind!
An American reporter in Japan becomes the unwitting subject of a mad scientist’s twisted experiment in this terrifying tale of ambition gone berserk.

programmes.t: X: The Man With The X-Ray Eyes
programmes.d: In this cult-classic, a driven scientist discovers that his x-ray vision formula brings with it incredible powers…and incredible temptations.

A 300-year old vampire (rock star Adam Ant) tries to "re-humanize" after falling in love with a beautiful "mortal."  His attempts are thwarted, however, by his jealous vampire lover and his new love's jealous fiancee.  Can an ancient vampire find love and happiness in the 20th century?
Every 22 years, a jinxed vampire is fated to lose his beloved at the hands of a crazy pirate. But with his new band, he’s going to end the curse!
Mark wants to go all the way. His girlfriend won’t, but he meets a beautiful vampire who will! The problem? He’s starting to feel a little batty.
After being bitten on the neck during a night of passion, an agent is convinced he's a vampire.

The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel

programmes.t: Howling II: Your Sister Is A Werewolf
programmes.d: In this cult-classic sequel, when the brother of doomed newscaster Karen White, her co-worker and a mysterious stranger (Christopher Lee) set out to save the world from a werewolf invasion, they must first destroy an immortal werewolf queen!

programmes.t: The Return Of The Living Dead
programmes.d: On his first day at a medical supply warehouse, Freddy (Thom Mathews) unwittingly releases toxic gas from a secret U.S. military canister. The gas reanimates an army of corpses, who arise from their graves with a ravenous hunger...for human brains!
On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!
Colonel West returns from an historic trip to Saturn with a strange ailment: his flesh is melting! And only human flesh and blood will keep him alive!

John Saxon, Dennis Hopper and the legendary Basil Rathbone star in this atmospheric -- and influential -- sci-fi cult classic as a team of astronauts embark upon a rescue mission to Mars only to encounter a seductive alien, The Queen of Blood!
The legendary Mario Bava directs this cult-classic tale of extra-terrestrial terror when an alien race targets a crew of unsuspecting astronauts.
When an evil troll attempts to forever erase mankind, a sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his plan.

Disguised as friendly country folk, a posse of people-eating trolls lures visitors to their town, and a family of four is about to discover this place is a real tourist trap. Now, the no-good gnomes must be destroyed before the family gets flambed.
The family that slays together stays together when six young travelers find themselves at the mercy of the eccentric Ma, Pa and their "children."
When a nine-year-old boy sees the ghost of a girl being murdered, he bravely sets out to solve the crime, but the killer may be closer than he knows!

Struggling actress Mary Steenburgen is offered the film role of a lifetime by the mysterious Roddy McDowall. But all is not as it seems and, as the pieces fall into place, her quest for stardom becomes a fight for survival in this twisty thriller.
It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!

Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

Lee Van Cleef and  John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programmes.t: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programmes.d: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

James Coburn portrays an aging, philandering rodeo cowboy who returns to his hometown. He must do battle not only in the rodeo arena, but with his desire for personal independence and his contradictory desire to win the respect of his wife and son.

Jack (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil (Sam Waterston) are an oddball team of modern-day Montana cattle rustlers, and they've set their sights on a pair of unlikely ranch owners from New York (Clifton James, Elizabeth Ashley). But can they outfox the foxes?

Jeff Bridges stars as Wild Bill Hickok, the hard-drinking, quick-shooting gunslinger who lived on the edge. Hickok's amazing story is told with a stunning visual style, illuminating one of the most exciting heroes of the American West.

Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

Charles Bronson gives a standout performance as an Apache on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer (Jack Palance). Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed deep into the Apache desert.

When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.
In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother…who is blind.
Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.
Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!
Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

Charlie Silvercould III carries around a family curse passed down from his grandfather; death by a milk truck on his 25th birthday. With eight days left, Charlie accepts his fate and starts taking care of his unfinished business, until he meets a girl who won't let him die in peace.

The last two surviving members of the Piripkura people, a nomadic tribe in the Mato Grasso region of Brazil, struggle to maintain their indigenous way of life amidst the region's massive deforestation.

programmes.t: Boobs: The War On Women's Breast
programmes.d: The films investigates the controversy swirling around the breast cancer screening test mammography.

Cancer: The Integrative Perspective takes a deep dive into the fast-expanding paradigm of holistic and integrative wellness approaches for preventing and reversing cancer that treats the disease with conventional tools, while also supporting patients’ strength, stamina and quality of life with evidence-based natural therapies.

From claims of buried technology which drastically improves gas mileage, to bureaucratic governmental roadblocks, to consumers’ reluctance to embrace alternatives, GAS HOLE provides a detailed examination of America’s continued dependence on foreign oil and sheds light on the economic and sociological forces that have contributed to that dependence.

Cancer survivor and filmmaker Erik E. Crown joins local water activists to investigate accelerated cancer rates and other illnesses in central Florida communities, tracing the source to phosphate mining and the pollution of the state's waterways by a multinational corporation.
The Land of Little Rivers, a network of tributaries in the Catskill Mountains of New York, is the birthplace of fly fishing in America and home to anglers obsessed by the sport.

Bread is a branded product with an endless number of varieties and providers. But do we actually know what we eat every day? We meet small craft bakers who stand up for their quality and we meet CEOs who work on bread as an industrial mass product which becomes increasingly artificial. How can traditional bakery skills survive? And how will the future of bread look like?

SHARING THE HARVEST follows farmers who reject conventional agriculture's growth pressures. Filmmaker Philipp Petruch explores three solidarity farming initiatives aiming to build sustainable, community-supported food systems. Through community, courage, and a new consumer-producer relationship, they show how we can transform agriculture - and the world.

programmes.t: JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC
programmes.d: Lack of physical activity is a growing problem, with over 50% of adults and 80% of young people in high-income countries being insufficiently active. The documentary JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC shows how we can reignite the desire for movement and overcome inactivity.
In Sun City, the retirement community in Arizona, the residents show us how to make the best of life when death casts its shadow in old age – with attitude!
We discuss how new parents can fuel their love life. Plus, ways to get more creative during foreplay. These topics and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.
How often do men really think about sex? Plus, we talk about ways to maintain intimacy when you're both the caretaker and the lover.
Alcohol may help get you in the mood but how does it affect your sex life? And do men fake orgasms? All this and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Jill Bolte Taylor, a Harvard-trained and published neuroanatomist. She shares with us the idea of cellular circuitry and how there are four distinct modules of cells that make up who we are, combining the thinking mind and the emotional side. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

Why has infertility become so normal? Better yet – why are women the only one’s taking on the burden of infertility? The statistics on the amount of women struggling with PCOS (making them infertile) are only rising and with men being responsible for 50% of infertility, the conversation needs to change.

What if the key to a vibrant, healthy life lies in returning to our ancestral roots? In this episode of Rooted in Wellness, I’m joined by Dr. Darshan Shah who works to merge ancient healing practices with modern-day science to help his patients extend both their lifespan and more importantly, their healthspan.

Between work, family, and wellness, many women feel like they're running on empty. Mona shares empowering tools and mindset shifts to help women balance it all—without burning out. Fulfillment is possible when you root into what matters.

In this course, Anita Moorjani guides you toward loving yourself as if your life depends on it – because it does! When love (rather than fear) determines your life, you will recognize what is truly important for you to be happy and healthy.

Today, Anita shares what her near-death experience taught her about how to live. You’ll discover why everything we have learned through our education system, government, mass media, etc. is the exact opposite of what we should know in order to create a meaningful, joy-filled life.
Today, we take a close look at who we really are in order to recognize our purpose, understand our intentions, and recognize our true worth in this world.

We live in a fear-based world. In today’s lesson, Anita offers you tools that have been specially created to overcome your fears with love. This is the greatest lesson she learned during her near-death experience when she traveled to the other side. It’s the lesson that saved her life.

Today’s meditation will guide you through forgiveness. Of letting go of obstacles and fears that hold you back from living the life you desire to live. By doing so, you’ll be able to forgive everyone who has hurt you in this life, release emotional baggage that may be weighing heavy on you, and step into a new realm of possibility.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day one explores core teachings from A Course in Miracles: releasing ambition, ego, and grandiosity to become a compassionate presence. Rather than fixing or leading, we learn to hold space, trust divine guidance, and allow true healing and spiritual transmission to unfold.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day 2 of Teaching the Teachers explores the core teaching that only love is real and fear is illusion. Not a religion, the Course offers a non-dogmatic spiritual path that can complement other teachings and invites surrender to a higher power for true healing.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day Three of Teaching the Teachers reveals that the ego conceals our perfect, God-created Self. We are not our bodies, and life continues beyond birth and death. Thoughts create effects, yet through atonement we can be freed from guilt, fear, and suffering when we choose healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

A former special-forces agent (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) finds himself embroiled in police corruption and accused of murder.
Dr. John Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) treats a young couple (Bridget Fonda, Matthew Broderick) for their imagined ailments at his Michigan sanitorium circa 1907.
After a series of misfortunes, a woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) with an unfaithful boyfriend (John Lynch) experiences an alternate reality.
Miniature dinosaurs help a boy outwit a malevolent governess who wants to pack him off to a military boarding school.
Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.
A shy teenage outcast (Hugh O'Conor) uses his chemistry genius to poison his family and others in '60s England.
An Irish hustler (Robert Arkins) puts together a Dublin band that covers hits of 1960s American soul.
A bank robber (Steve McQueen) and his wife (Ali MacGraw) cross a big shot (Ben Johnson) and are chased to the Mexican border.

En Colombia, varios casos de muertes neonatales han revelado graves negligencias médicas. Las familias afectadas buscan justicia. La falta de leyes que protejan a las madres ha llevado a impulsar una legislación para prevenir la tragedia.

Fernanda, Marleny y Jonathan son víctimas de préstamos digitales que se convierten en cobros intimidantes. Séptimo Día investiga Call Centers que usan tácticas de intimidación para cobrar deudas. Las autoridades y expertos advierten sobre los riesgos de estas aplicaciones.

En las sombras de las cárceles colombianas, las visitas conyugales se convierten en escenarios de horror. Reclusos peligrosos, aprovechando fallas en la seguridad, transforman momentos íntimos en tragedias.
Carolina, de 48 años y de nacionalidad venezolana, cuenta su experiencia en el modelaje webcam.
Ana Lucía quiere justicia luego de que su padre la dejara embarazada a los 14 años y nunca fue a la cárcel.

Ángela Carolina, una menor de edad, fue hallada muerta en una fosa común en Villa Rica, Tolima. John Fredy, de 31 años, confesó ser el autor intelectual del crimen, motivado por un odio hacia su esposa Yuli Marcela tras una infidelidad. Fue condenado a 36 años de prisión por homicidio agravado contra la menor y su esposa. Ahora, pretende cambiar su versión, pero las autoridades no le dan validez.
El 23 de junio de 2014 en Chinchiná, Alfair Sabogal atacó brutalmente a seis miembros de una familia por celos e intentó matar a su pareja, Diana Marín, quien quedó con secuelas visuales.
En La Montañita, Caquetá, Jhon Jairo Marín rehace su vida con Yineth Mosquera, quien, celosa del hijo de su pareja, Esneider, termina atentando contra la vida del menor.

En 2012, en Cúcuta, Johana Rincón fue hallada muerta en su casa con señales de tortura. Aunque su esposo fue el primer sospechoso, la investigación reveló que el verdadero culpable era su sobrino, quien la asesinó para robar los ahorros de su tío. Tras huir a Venezuela y esconderse durante varios días, fue capturado por la Policía al regresar a Colombia.

La familia Peña, famosa por su negocio de papas y altruismo, enfrentó extorsión y amenazas. Milciades intentó proteger a Rubiela y su hija, pero la situación trágicamente terminó en un triple asesinato.
¡Anamaria asesina a Lourdes por millones y oculta el cuerpo! Sumida en sospechas, culpa a otra amiga. Condenada a 38 años, logra casa por cárcel. ¡Escapa del brazo de la ley!

En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

En 2009, Ángela María Mejía confesó matar a su esposo Edilson Guzmán. Sus amigos Pedro y Yolanda la encubrieron, pero Yolanda luego descubrió que Pedro era amante de Ángela y la delató. Ángela fue capturada por homicidio y otros delitos.

Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.

Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.

Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.

Iván René Valenciano, exgoleador de la selección Colombia, reveló su lucha contra el insomnio, que lo llevó a automedicarse con Zolpidem hasta niveles peligrosos. Tras retirarse del fútbol y enfrentar adicciones, encontró alivio en marihuana medicinal de bajas dosis, siguiendo consejo médico. Sin THC alucinógeno, el tratamiento le ha devuelto la tranquilidad y calidad de sueño.

Diana Carolina Gutiérrez, influencer y coach de vida bogotana de 35 años, nació sin brazos debido a la Amelia, una malformación congénita. Estudió derecho y desarrolló habilidades excepcionales con sus pies para escribir, cocinar y cuidar de su hijo Emanuel. Sin complejos ni limitaciones, comparte su historia en redes sociales para inspirar a otros, con el sueño de ser conferencista.

Hoy, Marisol regresa por 12º vez para hacer la prueba de su 15º hombre. Luego, Dalyna vino a demostrar que Johnny Mack es el padre de su hijo. Él dice que es imposible porque le parece que el bebé es "demasiado feo" para ser suyo. ¿Qué dicen los resultados del ADN?

Hoy en MAURY, tenemos a madres y padres muy enfadados en negación. ¡Estos hombres juran que es imposible que sean los padres de los hijos de estas mujeres! Pero, ¿y si tienen razón? ¿Qué respuestas darán los resultados de ADN?
¿Quién es responsable del bienestar del pequeño Noel? Todo el mundo puede negar las acusaciones, pero alguien sabe qué pasó, y Steve va a obtener explicaciones.
Theresa y Darron fueron arrestados por poner en peligro a su hija y enfrentar cargos de abuso sexual. Megan sospecha que su prometido Mark golpeó a su bebé y le fracturó la pierna.
Ashley y DeNorris se acusan mutuamente de engaños; Jim niega haber tenido relaciones sexuales con la hermana de su prometida y con niñas menores de edad.
Una mujer se acuesta con el novio de su hermana gemela; un hombre queda atrapado entre dos mujeres; un hombre le pide a un amigo que mienta por él.

Misty odia tanto al marido que se acaba de casar con su mejor amiga que está dispuesta a pagar el divorcio. ¡Lucus está dispuesto a divorciarse de su esposa de 6 semanas si su familia no deja de entrometerse!
Alex se niega a perder a su exnovia sin luchar; CeeCee necesita revelar su verdadera identidad a la persona que le gusta en línea; Kyle y su hermana tienen secretos que confesar.
Anita está dispuesta a dejar a su marido por su ex-amante. Luego Theresa está siendo infiel a su prometido con su hermano. Más tarde Kevin viene a decirle al ex de su novia, Jermaine, que se aleje.
El único momento de debilidad de John puede costarle todo; Antonio conoce a su amor platónico; Paige intenta hacer que su novio la perdone por engañarla ofreciéndole un trío.

Varios compradores en Colombia enfrentan el incumplimiento de Constructores que no entregan sus viviendas. Tras años de espera, demandan por estafa y negligencia, mientras los proyectos siguen paralizados o en problemas legales.
Dos personas son estafadas por el Ejército Nacional al acudir a ellos con la cédula militar de sus familiares.

Gregorio es atracado en Bogotá sin recibir ayuda. Séptimo Día realiza un experimento social con actores para observar reacciones ante robos. Las respuestas varían entre ayuda y miedo. El sociólogo Carlos Charry analiza la falta de empatía y solidaridad. Las autoridades insisten en que deben ser ellas quienes actúen, no los ciudadanos.

La inseguridad en el transporte público colombiano es alarmante. Rocío Donado fue atacada en Transmilenio, Wilfrido Murcia asesinado en un bus SITP, y Erika Romero apuñalada en Bogotá. En Barranquilla, Dora Mendoza perdió a su hija en un robo. La falta de seguridad y la reincidencia de delincuentes agravan la situación.

Un hombre, múltiples crímenes. Jorge Ignacio Palma, condenado por el asesinato de tres mujeres y el intento de matar a otras seis, deja tras de sí un rastro de horror, preguntas sin respuesta y una madre que exige justicia y verdad.

Colombianos se unen al Ejército de Ucrania buscando un mejor futuro, enfrentando la guerra y la incertidumbre. La esperanza de estabilidad económica choca con la realidad de un conflicto brutal, dejando a familias en constante temor y dolor.
María Elena, vendedora ambulante, es asesinada por su novio Damián tras negarse a abortar su hijo. Su cuerpo es encontrado sin útero.

El 8 de marzo de 2010, dos niños fueron hallados muertos en Bogotá. Su madre, Ana Milena Yate, y su pareja, John Edison Zapata, fueron condenados a 60 años por el homicidio. Ambos participaron en el crimen tras una noche de alcohol y violencia.

Eduardo Pinto Viloria, Director Regional de Medicina Legal en Barranquilla, es asesinado a tiros en su casa. Lo que parecía un robo resultó ser un crimen orquestado por su esposa, Dayana Jassir De la Hoz, junto a su amante y tres cómplices, motivados por el seguro de vida y una prueba de ADN que reveló que Eduardo no era el padre biológico de su hijo. Todos fueron condenados por homicidio agravado.
¡Anamaria asesina a Lourdes por millones y oculta el cuerpo! Sumida en sospechas, culpa a otra amiga. Condenada a 38 años, logra casa por cárcel. ¡Escapa del brazo de la ley!

A los 15 años, Jenny Carolina Castro fue asesinada en Santander tras salir de la casa de su hermana. Su cuerpo fue hallado con heridas de arma blanca. Las autoridades señalaron a Sergio Gerena, su amante en secreto, como sospechoso tras evidencia de llamadas y un dije hallado en la escena. Gerena confesó el crimen, alegando que temía que un supuesto embarazo arruinara su relación.
Cindy Piña fue asesinada por su ex Edinson Dussán en abril de 2020 en Neiva, tras visitarlo para ver a sus hijos. Estaba embarazada de su nueva pareja. Él la enterró en el patio y confesó.

Julio Hermes formó una familia en Venadillo. Su hijo Jhon Andrés fue acusado de tener una relación incestuosa con su media hermana Angie Tatiana, quien quedó embarazada. En 2008, Angie desapareció y fue hallada muerta.

Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.
Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.
Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.
Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.
Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

Danna Sultana, artista trans colombiana, y Esteban, pesista trans puertorriqueño, sueñan con ser padres. Esteban lleva 5 meses de embarazo tras dejar hormonas. Viven libremente en Manhattan buscando cumplir sueños laborales postnacimiento.

La pandemia deja héroes anónimos: el personal de salud. Juan David Ramírez lidera el estudio más amplio sobre el COVID-19 en Colombia, explicando el comportamiento del virus y las medidas de prevención. El primer caso en Cartagena fue una turista británica, mientras que el doctor Lácides Caparroso, tras contagiarse atendiendo pacientes, sobrevivió tras perder 13 kilos, gracias a su fortaleza y apoyo médico.
En esta edición especial de The Maury Show, Maury invita a celebridades al escenario para compartir algunas de las imágenes reales más intensas e impactantes jamás grabadas.

Dashawn y su mamá afirman que lo de Monica fue una aventura de una sola vez y que él no puede ser el padre de su bebé. Entonces, la parrandera April quiere averiguar quién es el padre de su bebé. Después, ¿Frederick o Jason es el padre del bebé de Marietta?

Officers in Richland County, S.C., search for stolen golf carts.
Officers in Daytona Beach, Fla., use spike strips to stop a fleeing vehicle.

programmes.t: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programmes.d: Mandy Lane, a Texas high-school beauty, is invited by her classmates to a weekend getaway at a secluded ranch.
By day, Abby Russell is a dedicated nurse, but by night, she lures cheating men to their brutal deaths.
A small suburban neighborhood is stricken with a mysterious parasitic virus.
Captain Solomon Kane (James Purefoy) is a brutally efficient 16th Century killing machine.
When a terrifying Cyclops is terrorizing the Roman countryside the emperor sends in his strongest general.
A fallen warrior battles to avenge his dishonored master.
The disbanded Musketeers reunite to defeat a beautiful double agent and the scheming man she is working for.
As the Roman empire collapses, Romulus Augustus sets out for Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.
