A masked killer takes a woman from her home and crashes a Valentine's Day party, where the bloodshed continues
Kent dresses up in an old clown suit he finds, but soon discovers there's no way of removing it.
A runaway bride and her friends are stranded in a town full of sadistic clowns who don’t trust outsiders.
The story of the infamous Sawyer family and how one child was molded into the monster now known as Leatherface
A group of friends travel to a small town to check out an inheritance, but a terrifying ordeal awaits them.
When a family comes under attack, the killers learn one of victims harbors a secret talent for fighting back.
An ex-Confederate officer (Joseph Cotten) and his sons cross the desert with a coffin full of stolen Union cash.
Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.
The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.
Weather drives Silky to shelter at an isolated cabin. He sees that his arrival has complicated a family quarrel, but before anything comes of it, two outlaws barge in bringing bigger trouble.
No sooner has a gold prospector made plans to marry an Indian girl than his backers plot to chase the Indians off the tribal land. It seems that gold has been discovered there.

When young Jimmy arrives after his father, a sad failure, has been declared dead, Rocky and Reno tell him his father was a respected success. But when Jimmy overhears Hap being accused of cheating his father and turning him into a bum, he runs away.

Silky takes a mining job to repay borrowed money and finds himself the center of a stormy triangle between Fay, her husband Paul and their partner Arthur. Fay goads her jealous husband to kill Silky so she and Arthur can have the mine and each other.
Jennie's jealous suitor (Warren Oates) sets fire to the wagon where she and the Kissel brood are sleeping.
Jaimie must decide whether to relinquish a swindler he has befriended to Indians threatening the caravan.
Coulter accuses a wounded cavalry officer (Charles Robinson) of having deserted during an Indian attack.
Exasperated pioneers hire the ill-fated Donner Party's former trail guide to escort them back to their original homes.
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.
A sheriff's daughter runs off with her boyfriend (John Ericson), unaware he is a murderous bank robber.
For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.
An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.
Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white.
Little Joe runs into romantic complications when he tries to teach a deaf girl sign language; guest Albert Salmi.

The Sisters brothers find themselves on a journey through the Northwest, bringing them to the mountains of Oregon, a dangerous brothel in a small town and the gold rush land of California -- an adventure that tests the deadly family ties that bind.

programmes.t: The Wackiest Wagon Train in the West
programmes.d: A wagon master and his bumbling assistant guide a procession of one wagon, one luxurious coach and five people.

Corporal Webb finds a man who seems to have hanged himself after writing a suicide note. Webb notes this happened while the suicide was in the midst of cooking himself a meal, and concludes that all is not right in this part of Canada.
A professional gambler sets out to even the score with his father's killers, Copperheads terrorizing 1846 Kansas.
Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.
Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to search for missing people in Canada, and quickly finds out a gang of French Canadian outlaws have been kidnapping people.
Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.
Two outlaws threaten to expose a bank teller with a criminal past.
Outlaws target the home of Don Jose while he is leading the annual Ride of the Ranchers.
Pat Brady buys an old ghost town inhabited by a strange old man (Tom London).
Dale helps investigate the mayor (Harry Lauter) of a small town who is suspected of being corrupt.
A young carnival worker is framed for the murder of his boss.
Pat Brady is elected sheriff just in time to catch a notorious killer.
Roy hires an ex-con who is quickly suspected of committing several recent robberies.
A woman from Connecticut arrives at Dale's café seeking her father.
A greedy veterinarian plans to murder a blind prospector who is using Roy's dog.
Roy and Pat aid a boxer (Charles Bronson) who has criminal connections.
Con men trick an unsuspecting Dale into selling the ranch.
A group of cattle rustlers tries to sell stolen beef to Dale's café.
The owner of a gun used to kill a rancher protests his innocence.
Roy and Dale discover the body of a murdered Indian chief.
The Mingo Kid swaps clothes with Roy, who is then taken hostage by another outlaw.
The leader of a cattle rustling gang declares his innocence in the robbery of school funds.
After numerous altercations with a white stallion, Roy comes to the conclusion he's got to get rid of it.
Chance is reunited with the mother he's never known; the Champions join hands to punish Jeb Hollister and restore justice.
The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.
The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) pose as strangers and nab outlaws near the Mexican border.
Ted and Dusty infiltrate a band of outlaws to get close to Mr. Gentry, the man who murdered Ted's father.

The Art of FLIGHT follows Travis Rice, John Jackson, Mark Landvik, Scotty Lago, Jake Blauvelt, Nicolas Muller, Gigi Ruf, DCP and Pat Moore as they dream up new global adventures and progress the sport to unimaginable levels.
In this episode, Selema Masekela sits down with the most iconic figure in skateboarding history, Tony Hawk.
Venturing deep into the Florida Everglades for a unique backcountry fishing experience among the mangroves.
Targeting striped bass in the iconic waters of Chesapeake Bay and around Kent Island.
Jon Durand sets out to perform loop-the-loop hang-gliding aerobatics.
Troy Watson and Kieran McKay attempt to find will be the biggest cave in the southern hemisphere.
We venture to the Arabian Gulf for the unique Challenge Sir Bani Yas triathlon.
Josh Rosen dives headfirst into the rich culinary and adventure landscape of Ireland.

programmes.t: The Road Less Eaten with Biju Thomas
programmes.d: Biju heads to Alabama's Beaches to sample southern fare, featuring a hook and cook fishing trip and BBQ.

programmes.t: The Road Less Eaten with Biju Thomas
programmes.d: Biju visits the South Shore of Lake Tahoe to experience the stunning landscape, dining scene, and cuisine.
Vet Will tackles the challenge of relocating Harry, a feisty five-ton elephant
Jenna and Sean conduct a unique animal behavior experiment while Emma provides specialist genet care.
Downtown Greenville, South Carolina, is set to host the third year of an exhilarating criterium cycling.
Set around Town Center, The High Line Criterium offers unique viewing angles and nonstop racing action.

programmes.t: Red Bull: Keep Your Tips Up
programmes.d: Sean Pettit and his father, The Groovemeister head into BC for the GT Memorial NoBoard Race.

programmes.d: Sean Pettit and the crew make their way to Niseko for some five-star snow.
After 8 months of competition around the globe, the inaugural Slopestyle Super League Finals have arrived.
IRONMAN World Championship in Kona, where triathletes will etch their names into triathlon history.
An eco-minded journey to a different way of living.
Harriet fights on the frontline of human-elephant conflict, a crisis threatening communities and wildlife.
Off the Grid delivers the fiercest line-up of adventurous skiers in the deepest snow and steepest mountains.
Down a mountain is easy. Use skis or a snowboard. Getting up and around the area is a different matter.
Off the Grid delivers the fiercest line-up of adventurous skiers in the deepest snow and steepest mountains.
The “Boneyard,” Whistler Mountain Bike Park, Rhapsody Slopestyle offers the best MTB bikers on the planet.

The heat descends into chaos as the house robots team up to take down the competitors. The judges make a controversial decision in the final to decide this week’s winner.
Over halfway through the heats and the hopefuls are still lining up to put their robots through mechanical hell, for a chance of making it to the semi-finals.
An apparent malfunction gives a veteran competitor an opportunity to redeem themselves in the eliminators. The World Champion returns to take on the Pinball Warrior.
Sparks fly in this week’s heat as competitors put their weapons to good use and a robot uses its shape to their advantage.
Celebrities take to the arena, teaming up with veterans from the series and their robots. The celebrities must control the robots for at least 60 seconds before the professionals can take over.

The eliminator begins slowly, but as the battle heats up the robots must stay cool, or they might end up losing their head. The house robots see one of their busiest nights in the arena as they try to keep up.

Four teams take part in the tag team terror tournament. Two teams comprised of two robots enter the arena at once. Only one robot is allowed to battle, only being able to switch with their team-mate by entering their team’s coloured zone.

Robot fightings newest competition begins! In the first heat, meet new robots and some familiar faces as teams get a feel for the arena and size up their competition. Filmed in Grantham in front of a live audience, robots battle for survival in the Robots Live Arena.

Heat 2 of the UKs most brutal robot combat competition takes the action to Crawley in the south of England. Winners and losers from Heat 1 face fresh opponents, fighting to secure a win and guarantee their place in the finals.

Its the last chance for teams to secure a spot before the final. In savage and tactical 1v1 matches, teams battle for a place in the top 16. New robots join the fray, hoping for a last-minute victory to advance to the championship.

The most battle-hardened combat robots in the UK compete in the MechMania Grand Final. After three grueling heats, only the toughest survive. The tournament is now a single-elimination, 1v1, sudden-death formatuntil one team emerges as the victorious champion.

Northerners compete in an annihilator. In the first round, all six robots would fight each other until one of them was eliminated. The process continued until only two robots remained, with the subsequent winner becoming the annihilator champion.
The South’s turn for the annihilator. Same rules, different robots.
The UK and USA battle it out to prove which country has the better robots. Each country has four robots representing and fighting for them. A straight knockout competition will determine a victor.
The heats resume this week, and one competitor has its own entrance ceremony. Gemini returns to the arena to prove themselves in Pinball Warrior.
Renowned robot Firestorm 2 takes on Pinball Warrior this week and the heats are nearing their end. The house robots show no mercy against a flipped robot.
Not even the arena floor is safe in this week’s eliminators, as the competitors go all out to best the opposition. One robot manages to take control in the heat finals.

An impressive weapon manages to fight off two robots simultaneously, ripping through armor and insides. As one of the finalists is still reeling from the previous rounds, will they manage to come back and take the finals?
Heat winners gather for the beginning of The Fourth Wars semi-finals. Pinball Warrior and Sumo Bash make way for the brutal knockout competition.
The last stage before the Grand Finals, and the pressure is on. With this level of carnage not all robots may leave the arena as they fight for the title, and their lives.
The Fourth Wars is coming to an end, beginning with two rounds of playoffs, where four will be whittled down to two. Of the remaining two, one will become Robot Wars: The Fourth Wars champions.
A hurricane has left the city in flames. Can the team extinguish the inferno before it’s too late?
Severe weather jeopardises vital research information, the Rescue Robots must navigate their way through a dangerous minefield to retrieve it.
A test plane has crash landed, the Rescue Robots are tasked with finding the cause of the crash, before the fuel tanks explode.
The Rescue Robots must disable rogue military robots before they wreak havoc on Calamity City.

An unidentified object from outer-space has crashed in the desert on the outskirts of Calamity City and is leaking radiation, the Rescue Robots must retrieve and contain the object before it causes harm to the city.

Four more stars team up with professionals to test their battle ability. Will it lead them to fame and fortune, or will they end up being thrown to the curb along with the other scraps?

Realizing Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father, Hoon agrees to arrange her marriage to Soo. Meanwhile, Flower Crew begins the difficult task of transforming Gae Ttong into a proper noble lady.

Gae Ttong continues her training to become a noble lady. Joon helps Lady Yim and realizes his memories of his mother were wrong. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor discovers that Soo has been deceiving him.
Gae Ttong suddenly confesses her love to Hoon. While Hoon tries to avoid her, Soo grows anxious after overhearing them. He meets Lady Kang and asks Lord Kang to speed up the royal wedding.
Hoon and Gae Ttong confess their love, but a marriage ban is declared until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Lord Kang investigates Flower Crew and discovers Young Soo's true identity.

Hoon tells Soo that his marriage to Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang forces Gae Ttong into the queen selection process using her secret against her. At the palace, Gae Ttong finally learns Soo's true identity.

Furious over Soo and Hoon's deception, Gae Ttong refuses to remain a noble lady. But Moon Seok warns that many lives depend on her becoming queen. After a beautiful day with Hoon, she prepares to say goodbye.
Gae Ttong enters the second queen selection, but an astrologist claims she has the fortune of the dead. Soo discovers a political scheme, while Kang and Young Soo are taken in for interrogation.
The Chief and Second State Councillors plot treason. Gae Ttong is kidnapped to force Hoon's cooperation, while Young Soo is imprisoned. Joon uses all his resources to find where they are being held.
Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.
Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.
Hoon allows Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. After losing clients, the crew takes a case involving scholar Lee Hyung Gyu, but Hoon suspects he is hiding something.

Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.
Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.
The Rogue dies mysteriously in prison, leaving Hoon with the words "Fox Guard." Hoon and Joon search for the killer. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong reunites with her brother Kang, raising Ji Hwa's suspicions.
Soo finally reunites with Gae Ttong and promises to marry her. However, Hoon realizes he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, his investigation into the Rogue's death leads him closer to the truth.

Andy, Dov, Gail, and Nick undertake a risky plan to prove that Commissioner Alonso Santana is corrupt.
A heat wave hits and Jarvis opens the division to the public as a cooling station.
Now that Sam and Marlo’s baby girl has arrived, it’s clear nothing could have prepared Andy for this moment.
With the 15 Division restructure looming, Andy and Sam’s wedding lets the gang celebrate one last hurrah.

As the other rookies hunt for an escaped convict, Swarek lets Andy in on his past undercover exploits.
The rookie cops duke it out for a cause at “Fite Nite.”

Silvia starts with the basics. How do Italian home cooks shop for pantry staples and fresh produce? A guided visit to an Italian deli leads to shopping and preparing of: a rustic Tuscan chickpea pasta, bakes 2 succulent and savoury Schiacciata breads and Silvia's mothers Apple and Mascarpone cake. Proving that when an Italian pantry is well stocked you only need a few fresh ingredients to create simple yet memorable meals

If renting a red Vespa and embarking on a road trip from the top of Italy all the way down to the bottom of the "boot," isn't fitting your schedule any time soon, Silvia has 3 recipes that will take you on that journey. From an incredible zucchini filled strudel with all the flavours of Calabria to a pesto linguine from Genoa that is 100 % not to be missed.

Willie B goes on location to experience a two day build school for a Factory Five Roadster.
Kevin and Willie swap out performance headers on a Z51 Corvette, showing how not all headers are alike.
Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the interior of a C20. Changing out the seats, dash accessories and door panels. We’re going from Clean to Custom on Truck U.
Matt and Bruno show you how to personalize your Jeep with some paint and fabrication.
It’s a fishing day on Truck U. Matt and Bruno take two trucks and get them ready to tow with a turbo rebuild and some towing accessories.
To sell this Longbed C-10, Matt and Bruno need to get it back to stock. They transform the interior back to a factory style bench seat.  The exhaust also gets a factory style upgrade.
Patina C-10 trucks are all the rage. Matt and Bruno leave the paint alone on a 69’ C10 project and give it the fine details it needs to look like a finished look.
It’s back, the new Ford Raptor is here and Matt and Bruno can already make it faster and sound better with aftermarket parts.
Matt and Bruno find a lowrider truck that has some handling problems. So they fabrication some suspension components and do some interior work.

Line ‘em up. It’s a Chevy day on Truck U as Bruno and Matt look at a couple of bowtie trucks in the shop. They do everything from styling upgrades to common problem fixes, and as always, they give you some life lessons along the way.
Willie shows off the new engine in his ‘67 Barracuda and gets Kevin to help upgrade his wiring and brakes.
When a 1949 Chevy pick-up shows up at the shop, Kevin and Willie take a look at how far technology has come.
The guys tackle an issue with runout on a good set of rotors with the use of an on-car lathe.
The guys do a complete deconstruction of the new Scorpion diesel engine, showing how the new technology and block design completely revolutionized the 6.7L engine.
Kevin and Willie take the engine out of a C5 Corvette, tear it down, and get it ready for a performance rebuild.
The guys swap out a damaged clutch on a 2012 Mustang and go for performance with a lightweight twin plate clutch.
Our C5 project continues with a build up of the lower end of the LS1 engine.
The suspension gets completely reworked on the C5 Corvette.  Then the guys finish up the engine, getting it ready for re-install.
It’s time to beat the drums off a 1965 F100. Matt and Bruno do a full disc brake conversation and upgrade the master cylinder and booster.
Today on Truck U, we blend Matt’s love for the outdoors with Bruno’s love for performance and styling on a Jeep JK.
Bruno and Matt try to find a way to void the factory warranty on a long haul Tundra.
Matt helps a buddy get his Ram 2500 Longhorn ready for it’s next camping and hunting trip. As a trade out he gets a little party time in the trailer.
Matt and Bruno have a large Truck U checklist. They have to get a Bronco Project running again. Bruno has a racer friend stopping by who needs a hand and Matt shows us the new shop purchase.
Time to get low with a K5 Blazer. Matt and Bruno are going to C-notch the frame and and this 73’ blazer while still using the factory wheels and tires.
Bruno takes a trip to San Antonio, Texas to meet the soldiers of Operation Comfort and see what makes their Bronco Weapons Carrier so special
Bruno and Matt put together a Monster transmission from scratch and start building the tube chassis for the Rock Racer
Jeeps are notoriously underpowered, but it’s nothing a supercharger can’t fix.
The guys do their best to help a friend out with some body damage on a 1950 5-window pickup truck.  Will it become too much to handle?
A 2000 Silverado comes into the shop with a recurring cooling problem.  The guys put their detective hats on and find the root of the problem.
The guys learn what it takes to finish King of the Hammers with the ESAB sponsored Ultra Four race truck in the shop.

Kevin and Willie B. highlight the inner workings of the EcoBoost engine and show how it’s changing the game on the racetrack.  Plus, Kevin gets a rare look behind the doors of Ford Racing’s dyno facility.
Willie B. and Kevin do some detective work on a ‘55 Nomad that may be the next addition to Willie’s collection.  Meanwhile, a Jeep Wrangler is in the shop for an illuminating upgrade.
Kevin heads to the world-renowned Pratt & Miller Engineering Headquarters for a closer look at the company’s upcoming projects and legendary past.
Kevin and Willie B. tap into the pent-up power of a Ford F-150 EcoBoost by adding a new water-methanol injection system, intake, and exhaust before strapping it to the dyno.
Not all trucks are perfect. Matt and Bruno dissect some common Ford problems in the engine and suspension.
Bruno and Matt improve the ride quality and tow capacity on our Ford Super Duty tow project by installing an adjustable airbag system.
We finish the Air Bag kit on our Super Duty tow project and put it to the test on the road.
Bruno and Matt install some upgrades on a 2010 Ford F 150 to make it more roadworthy
Matt heads out west to find out what makes the King of the Hammers one of the fastest growing races in the world.
Bruno Massel takes a trip to Huntington Beach, California to see  a garage of Dream Cars that inspired a company.
The Chassis for the Rock Racer is almost done, so Matt and Bruno add a Speedwire System and install the torque converter.
Matt and Bruno replace a small engine on a go kart and get some help from some kids on a special project.
Willie B. and Kevin bring in a high-mileage truck for a routine check-up and walk us through some repairs every car owner should know.
Kevin and Willie B. take on the challenge of outfitting a Jeep for a rental company whose customer base isn’t known for driving cautiously.
Kevin and Willie take a factory-supercharged Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 to the dyno and put its full horsepower potential to the test by adding a water-methanol injection system.
Willie B. and Kevin bring an old 442 into the shop in hopes of bringing it back to life, starting with a new engine and transmission.
The team at TheBlock.com asks for help from Kevin and Willie B. to outfit the ultimate road trip truck and raise awareness for a worthy cause.
Kevin and Willie give a classic C-10 pickup a few improvements.  Meanwhile, work continues on an ongoing 2015 truck project.
Kevin and Willie are on a mission to finally finish two ongoing projects that have been taking up space in the garage.
Willie B. and Kevin bring in a big truck with a big number on the odometer, in hopes they can keep it running for many more miles.
Bruno and Matt need to create an ultimate truck for work and play. They get a visit from Clint at ATS Diesel and find out what’s available in the aftermarket for performance.
Work continues on the Dodge Work and Play Project Truck. Today, we help the ride with a wireless air bag system and add some much needed storage capability.
Learn why a truck’s steering geometry is such an important issue to address after installing a lift kit on your truck.
What causes a misfire in your engine? Follow Bruno and Matt as they travel through a diagnostic journey to find an answer to the problem.
Matt and Bruno take an enclosed car trailer and turn it into a toy hauler with all the amenities of home.
Matt and Bruno diagnose a “no-start problem” on an ‘05 Chevy Silverado and get some help with the repair from NASCAR Crew Chief Alan Gustafson.
Whether they are on the road, or in the garage, Bruno and Matt find answers to technical questions everyday. Today, they will answer some of your viewer questions while working on a new truck.
One million miles may sound like a lot – but NOT for a Cummins Diesel engine. Today, we’ll find out what makes these incredible engines built to last.

The ghouls detail and assemble the suspension of the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The owners of the '70 Plymouth Superbird, in the queue for resurrection, visit the shop and Daren convinces the crew to throw a birthday party for Mark.

Mark takes some time for himself and leaves Daren in charge of the shop. The crew gets the newly painted panels installed on the '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car. And Mark discovers a chip on the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car and no one will own up to it.

The fuel and brake lines are installed in the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car. Daren quits and won't return until Mark begins the restoration of his '70 Plum Crazy Challenger. A phone-call from the Phantasm car owner forces Mark to make a promise he might not be able to keep.

The GYC crew is under the gun to get the '71 Cuda 340 Triple Black 'Phantasm' Tribute car finished by the end of the week. With the exhaust, ornamation, and the engine start still ahead of them, will they be able to finish the car before the director of the 'Phantasm' movie franchise arrives?

Mark and the team rush to complete the triple-black, '71 Cuda, Phantasm homage car. The director and star of Phantasm, Don Coscarelli and A. Michael Baldwin, visit Graveyard Carz to check out the homage car and hopefully, drive it around town.

The team tears down Mike Hill's '70 Superbird and finishes up final touches on Chris Driscoll's '70 AAR Cuda. Daren confronts Mark about stealing parts from his car and Mark gets a rematch on Chris Driscoll's race track.

Holly asks Mark if she can work on cars. Mark Cain from Bad Boy Blasters brings the crew a huge gift. The '70 Barracuda Convertible is torn down and sent to the dipper, progress is made on the '70 Sunroof Challenger and Mark gets a surprise from one of his favorite actors.

Mark installs the hood decal on the '70 Sunroof Challenger, Holly helps Josh disassemble the Barracuda suspension, Mark and Daren work on the 440 engine for the Challenger, and the team assembles one of the rarest Mopar options, the sunroof for the '70 Challenger.

The team rushes to ready the '69 Dodge Daytona for Tom Partridge and his family's visit. The guys settle a leadership dispute the old fashioned way, the Graveyard Carz van gets a face lift, and Daren retaliates when Mark won't let him sign for deliveries.

Holly helps Mark on the '70 Challenger, Daren annoys everyone with his popcorn and causes Mark to damage a very rare car. Tony D'Agostino, from Tony's Mopar Parts, visits and lends a hand on the '70 sunroof Challenger. Mark let's Holly in on the big secret and Daren reveals a secret of his own.

A live concert production offers a mixture of the Wild West with the soulful sound of Italy.

The Rückert-Lieder are a collection of five art songs by Mahler, set to poems by Friedrich Rückert, showcasing his gift for intimate and deeply personal musical expression in a style that balances simplicity with profound emotional complexity.
Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

The Paris Opera Ballet performs the work choreographed by Rudolf Nureyev.

The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).
Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.
In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.
The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.
The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there
In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

Scott and Liam protect the lacrosse team from an attack by the Ghost Riders while Lydia searches for clues that lead her closer to finding Stiles.
Trapped inside the Wild Hunt, Stiles reunites with an unexpected ally while Scott, Lydia and Malia discover Stiles’s Jeep may be connected to his disappearance.
Scott, Lydia and Malia search for clues about the Wild Hunt in a mysterious place called Canaan while Liam and Hayden resort to drastic measures in the fight against the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam attempt to capture a Ghost Rider while Malia and Peter search for a way into the Wild Hunt.
Running out of time, Scott, Lydia and Malia decide to storm the rift in a desperate attempt to get Stiles back. Liam, Hayden and Mason make a deal with Theo in order to learn Douglas's real plan.
While Liam and Theo act as decoys, Scott, Lydia and Malia enact a desperate plan to try and remember Stiles.
With the fate of Beacon Hills hanging in the balance, Scott and his pack face off against Douglas in a final showdown.
As Scott readies Beacon Hills for his imminent departure, a mysterious presence breaks out of Eichen House.
Scott and Malia search for the owner of a unique bullet, fearing that a new breed of werewolf hunter has come to Beacon Hills. At the same time, Lydia must face her own fears of Eichen House.
While Scott and the others desperately pursue a missing werewolf, Melissa and Argent investigate the nature of a strange body.
Scott, Lydia and Malia have to take drastic measures to quell the growing violence in Beacon Hills, while Liam endures his own gauntlet at the high school.
When Scott and the others try to protect two new werewolves, an unlikely ally joins the fight.
Liam and Theo attempt to draw the Hunters away from Beacon Hills.
After a shocking attack leaves the pack reeling, Scott sets out to recruit reinforcements.
Scott and the others must make a discovery before it’s too late.
Scott and Malia prepare for battle while Argent searches for an old ally.
Gerard initiates his final attack on the Supernaturals of Beacon Hills.

When teenager Scott McCall (Tyler Posey) is convinced by his best friend, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien), to join a search in the woods for a missing body, something comes out of the darkness to take a bite out of his side, changing his life forever.

Not aware that he has become a werewolf, Scott (Tyler Posey) must deal with hunters trying to catch him, another werewolf (Tyler Hoechlin) and the pressures of normal teen life, all while trying to get a second date with Allison (Crystal Reed).

Scott's (Tyler Posey) first date with Allison (Crystal Reed) ends up in confusion and turns into a dreaded "group date." Meanwhile, a mystery animal attack has Sheriff Stilinski (Linden Ashby) and the rest of Beacon Hills on the lookout.

With his life in danger, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) is forced to make reluctant allies out of Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien). While Scott tries to survive dinner with Allison's father (JR Bourne), Stiles attempts to keep Derek alive.

A new animal attack raises more questions among authorities. And when Scott (Tyler Posey) and Allison (Crystal Reed) skip school unannounced, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) must deal with the ever more aggressive werewolf hunters on his own.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) come up with ways for Scott to control the transformation in order to be with Allison (Crystal Reed), while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) attempts to make an ally of Scott in his battle with the hunters.

When Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) is savagely attacked by the Alpha, Scott (Tyler Posey), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) and their friends find themselves trapped in Beacon Hills High School at night where they face both questions and suspicions about each other.

With Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) on the run from Sheriff Stilinski (Linden Ashby), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) must help Scott (Tyler Posey) face his second full moon. Meanwhile, Jackson (Colton Haynes) tries to get closer to Allison (Crystal Reed).

Clues, including a prior encounter with Derek (Tyler Hoechlin), bring Jackson (Colton Haynes) to a dangerous revelation about Scott (Tyler Posey)…and his actions begin to threaten not only Scott's life, but his own as well.

With startling revelations weighing in on him, Scott (Tyler Posey) finds himself scrambling to protect the people he loves, including Allison (Crystal Reed) who begins to follow clues left by her Aunt Kate about her family history.

While struggling with family secrets, Allison (Crystal Reed) focuses on the Winter Formal dance. Meanwhile, as the tensions between werewolves and hunters rise to a boiling point, Scott (Tyler Posey) struggles to protect both friends and enemies.

In the season finale, Scott McCall (Tyler Posey) discovers one last clue which allows him to enlist both friends -- and even a previous enemy -- in order to stop the mysterious killings and win back Allison (Crystal Reed), the girl he loves.

When Lydia (Holland Roden) goes missing from the hospital, werewolves and hunters alike begin a search to discover not only where she is, but what she may have become. Meanwhile Jackson's (Colton Haynes) body seems to be fighting against the bite.

The night before a full moon, Isaac's father (John Wesley Shipp) is murdered. When Isaac (Daniel Sharman) is arrested, Scott (Tyler Posey), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) resolve to break him out before the Argents get to him.

Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to stop Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) from creating new werewolves, while Chris Argent (JR Bourne) decides to officially begin Allison's (Crystal Reed) training. Meanwhile, the new creature in Beacon Hills takes another victim.

When the shapeshifter strikes again, Scott (Tyler Posey) has to recruit a reluctant Allison (Crystal Reed) to acquire a rare book from Gerard's (guest star Michael Hogan) collection, while also once again surviving dinner with the Argents.

Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) becomes convinced that Lydia (Holland Roden) is the shapeshifter they're after since she seemed immune to its toxin, forcing Scott (Tyler Posey) to gather his friends -- and even some enemies -- to protect her.

With startling new information about the shapeshifter, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) hurry to protect their friends while Allison (Crystal Reed) is given an investigative task by her family. And there is "panic at the disco."

Lydia (Holland Roden) makes connections about the bite from Peter (Ian Bohen). Jackson (Colton Haynes) causes problems for Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) has a crisis of faith in his leadership abilities.

During a secret concert, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) come up with a method to trap the new shapeshifter. At the same time, Allison's mother (Eaddy Mays) comes up with a plan of her own to take care of Scott once and for all.

Even as his relationship with Allison (Crystal Reed) is further strained, Scott (Tyler Posey) must attend Lydia's (Holland Roden) birthday party while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) locks up his new wolves on their first full moon together.

With a secret revealed, Scott (Tyler Posey), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien), Melissa and Stilinski are taken hostage in the Sheriff's station. Allison (Crystal Reed) then tracks Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) to the station, bringing Argent and Gerard with her.

Scott (Tyler Posey) must help win the championship lacrosse game while also trying to figure out how to stop Gerard (Michael Hogan). At the same time, Alison (Crystal Reed) and Argent (JR Bourne) continue their hunt of Derek (Tyler Hoechlin).

In the second season finale, although everyone is still reeling from a shocking death on the lacrosse field, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends rush to figure out Gerard's (Michael Hogan) master plan…but Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) has his own plan.

In the exciting Season 3 premiere, a new Alpha Pack arrives to wreak havoc on Scott's (Tyler Posey) life, while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Isaac (Daniel Sharman) struggle to locate Erica (Gage Golightly) and Boyd (Sinqua Walls).

Allison and Lydia stumble on a clue to finding Boyd and Erica, while a childhood friend of Stiles goes missing. Meanwhile, Derek is surprised by the reappearance of someone from his past…someone he thought had died in the Hale house fire.

With Boyd (Sinqua Walls) and Cora (Adelaide Kane) on the loose and under the influence of the full moon, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) find that they may have to turn to an unlikely ally for help…Chris Argent (JR Bourne).

While Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to keep Isaac (Daniel Sharman) from engaging in a deadly confrontation with the Twins in school, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) attempts to prove his theory that the killings have absolutely nothing to do with werewolves.

During a bus ride to a cross country meet, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends flash back to the events of a preemptive strike against the Alphas that has left several injured and possibly one or more dead.

Stranded at a motel in Fairvale, California for the night because of a postponed meet, Scott (Tyler Posey) and the others suffer strange experiences that cause them to believe members of their own group may the mysterious killer's newest targets.

As the danger begins to move closer to Scott (Tyler Posey) his trusted mentor and boss, Deaton (Seth Gilliam), is threatened. Meanwhile, Kali (Felisha Terrell) and the twins (Charlie Carver and Max Carver) go after Derek (Tyler Hoechlin).

Seeking answers, Scott (Tyler Posey). Allison (Crystal Reed) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) hear stories told by two unlikely narrators -- Peter (Ian Bohen) and Gerard (Michael Hogan) -- and discover a secret about the color of a werewolf's eyes.

Two sly publishers hire Ann as a writer.
Don is left with no street clothes.
A new part insults minorities.
Ann's flamboyant Uncle Herbert is turning Ann and Donald's world upside down.
Ann reminds a writer of his late wife.
Ann's late Uncle Harry wills her an old trunk used during his career in vaudeville.
Donald gets cold feet about marriage and breaks their engagement.
Ann meets a Russian who moves in with her and won't leave.
Ann is tricked by a conman into shoplifting.
Running her father's restaurant is tough for Ann and Don after the staff comes down with a virus.
Ann makes friends with royalty and finds that the king is a youngster.
The stag party thrown by Don's buddies costs him his engagement to Ann.
Ann gets a modeling assignment at Belmont Racetrack and Don's buddies get caught up in betting.
Ann is assigned to picket in front of the Newsview Magazine building where Donald works.
Stuck in an elevator, Donald and Ann reminisce about their last five years together.
Ann wins a job in a commercial that involves her being abducted by two hoods.
Just as Ann arrives in New York and learns of her first acting assignment, her mother has bad news.
Ann baby-sits.
An auto mishap causes suits.
Ann and Don, on their way to visit Ann's parents, stop along the way for a picnic.
A wealthy suitor showers Ann with gifts.
When Donald's secretary goes on maternal leave, Judy Bessemer suggests hiring Ann as a substitute.
Mystery surrounds a baseball.
Ann waitresses at a club.
One of Ann's best friends gets a role in a Broadway play, and Ann becomes her understudy.
Ann's father is shocked when he learns she is to take a stage name and forsake that of her family.
Don's mother begins to dislike Ann because of the character she portrays in a soap opera.
Ann thinks Don is dating another.
Ann's apartment building is being "haunted" by an old movie theater organist (Sterling Holloway).
A member of Ann's acting workshop tries to buy her friendship.
Ann recalls when she spent the Christmas holidays at an almost-deserted boys school.
Actress Ann Marie and Don discover a ring from Ann's school beau in a box full of memorabilia.
Ann, working as a door-to-door saleswoman, unloads a defective shipment of footwear on her friends.
When Ann finds out how messy Don's apartment is, she hires a maid to help him clean the place up.
Donald hands Ann the manuscript for a novel he wrote, which she is suddenly convinced she lost.
Ann and Don accompany their eloping friends to Connecticut -- and disaster.
Ann almost ruins a surprise birthday party Don has arranged for her.
Ann's father presses Donald as to whether he intends to marry his daughter.
Ann accompanies Don on an interview and gets more involved than she'd anticipated.
City life is safe?
Ann seeks a producer's attention.
Ann's newlywed cousin, a confirmed moocher, moves in with Ann for his honeymoon.
Ann has a ball stuck to her foot the same night she is to accept a Tony Award for her friend.
Ann asks Don to write some material for her part in an important play.
Ann appears on a dating game show and fails to pick Don as her escort.
A walk-on role for a play starring Ethel Merman in a revival of Gypsy leaves Ann awestruck.
Ann auditions for a soda commercial that requires a performance on roller skates.
After yet another rejection of Donald's unpublished novel, Ann offers to submit it to her father.
Donald does a news story on computer dating and takes Ann along for the ride.
Donald gets Ann to house sit at his apartment and she runs into another friend of his.
Before Ann goes to Philadelphia for a play's nationwide tour, Donald tries to show her a good time.
Unable to tolerate life without Ann, Donald goes to Philadelphia to write a review of Ann's play.
Donald writes an article on a newfangled psychological exam, and tries to use it on the Baumans.
Ann and Donald decide to work on a play about her life, but creative differences get in the way.
Ann's movie role calls for a nude scene.
Ann struggles to cook everybody's favorite dishes for a Thanksgiving dinner.
A substitute agent sets Ann up on a publicity date with Dick Shawn, who knows nothing about it.
Ann is offered a high-fashion modeling assignment that means a trip to California.
Ann and a bachelor photographer make headlines that bring Don out to Hollywood from New York.
Ann buys theater tickets from a scalper as a Christmas present for the Baumans.
After Ann is injured on a movie set, Donald goes overboard in trying to take care of her.
After Ann models an expensive chinchilla stole, the owner insists that she borrow it.
Another family visit to Ann's parents in Brewster pits Donald against Lou.
Lou Marie buys theater and train tickets for sixty-five people from Brewster to see Ann in a play.
A commercial director tells Anne she has a face that no housewife would feel threatened by.
Ann suggests that her father escort Ethel Merman to a formal event.
Still obsessed with Ann, Noel Prince returns to New York to try to get her to marry him.
A scandal erupts when Donald's mother is invited to Ann's place and finds his pants in her closet.
Friend's athletic prowess admired.
A series of obscene phone calls prompts Ann to call the NYPD, who sends over a detective.
Injured Ann mistakes a doctor for Don.
Ann hires press agent Eddie Edwards to boost her career.
After a hunting trip, Donald decides to grow a beard, which doesn't necessarily turn Ann on.
Caroline calls Bill but doesn’t say where she is. Caroline goes job hunting with poor results.
Margo is mad when Ridge changes her design. Ridge threatens to fire Margo if she fed Bill information.
Eric is excited about Kristen coming to work with him. Beth tells Brooke she is catering the Forrester party.
Donna accuses Rocco of lying. Eric asks Margo to the dinner. Caroline still loves Ridge but needs time.
Thorne is upset to hear Caroline accepted Ridge’s ring. Beth tries to get out of the catering job but can’t.
Brooke decides to delay her wedding. Dave is understanding. Storm tells Brooke he thinks Beth and Eric dated.
Storm finds a stack of Beth’s overdue bills. Beth tells her family about the glamorous Forresters.
Bill asks Thorne about Ridge and Caroline. Bill tells Thorne he wishes Caroline had picked Thorne instead.
Stephanie warns Thorne not to get involved with Caroline. Caroline realizes Bill took her ring.
Storm is mad that Brooke’s police protection is ending. Thorne is sad about Ridge and Caroline’s date.
Donna tricks Rocco into looking after Katie. Caroline and Ridge have a romantic dinner.
Beth and Storm become furious when they discover Donna went to the party with Mark.
Mark pushes Donna to move in with him. Margo tells Eric she’s in love with him.
Margo tells Bill about her problem with Eric. Bill encourages Thorne to pursue Caroline.
Storm tells Donna he wants to meet Mark. Eric agrees with Margo that she should resign.
Stephanie asks Ridge if he ever dated Margo. Mark and Donna look at an apartment. Grandma Logan is mugged.
Ridge tells Alex to leave him and his family alone. Alex asks Storm to take a trip with her.
Brooke comforts Donna about Grandma Logan. Grandma Logan wakes up and tells Beth a lie to cover for Donna.
Storm and Beth wonder if Eric recognized her at the party. Ridge asks Thorne why he offered Caroline a job.
The Logans want Grandma Logan to move in but she refuses. Eric is mad that Stephanie knew that Margo resigned.
Storm thinks Mark is a little too slick for Donna. Mark is upset that Donna is having second thoughts.
Thorne reveals his feelings to Caroline. Eric asks Stephanie if she wants a divorce.
Ridge visits Caroline and tells her he will wait for her. Thorne invites Alex to dinner to interview Eric.
Dave tells Brooke the police caught Grandma Logan’s muggers. Mark tells Rocco to leave Donna alone.
Caroline asks Ridge who he slept with before the wedding. Ridge doesn’t want to say.
Brooke and Storm prepare for their graduation ceremonies. Donna tells Katie she doesn’t want to go to college.
Storm asks Alex to dinner. She decides to cancel her plans with Thorne. Eric finally realizes who Beth is.
Caroline recognizes Brooke and suggests they get together sometime. Eric approaches Beth and they speak.
Donna tells Katie she feels trapped at home. Brooke tells Beth she finds Ridge fascinating.
Donna tells Katie about her plan to move out. Rocco tells Katie to tell the family for Donna’s sake.
Thorne accuses Stephanie of favoring Ridge. Donna tells her family she is moving out.
Caroline calls Brooke and they agree to meet. Ridge is upset to learn Alex interviews both Thorne and Eric.
Stephanie asks Caroline to set Kristen up with eligible men. Ridge is upset that Thorne went behind his back.
Bill wants Thorne to take over if he marries Caroline. Brooke and Caroline get to know each other.
Rocco defends Katie against bullies and gives her a big kiss. Kristen asks Eric about his college sweetheart.
Rocco tells Donna to dump Mark and move home. Stephanie is suspicious when Eric leaves for his date with Beth.
Eric tells Beth he left her because Stephanie got pregnant. Brooke is happy to play tennis at the Forrester's.
Thorne is uncomfortable about being set up with Brooke. Stephanie suspects Eric is being unfaithful.
Eric tells Margo about his meeting with Beth. Brooke invites Caroline over the same night Storm invites Alex.
Ridge is shocked to hear Thorne has been offered another job. Bill comforts Margo about Eric.
Brooke tries to set Storm up with Caroline but Storm says he is with Alex. Katie and Rocco go to visit Donna.
Storm decides to call Caroline. Storm thanks Rocco for helping Katie. Ridge tells Caroline about his concerns.
Thorne and Kristen try to find out who Eric is seeing. Kristen is surprised her parents' marriage has lasted.
Donna is fired, she and Mark get into a fight. Margo tells Ridge Eric is involved with someone from college.
Ridge asks Thorne about his job offer. Beth tells Stephanie someone else will supervise Eric’s party.
Donna is thankful when Rocco gets her a job. Beth won’t see Eric anymore because Stephanie loves him.
Mark is angry to learn Donna will be working with Rocco. Rocco rescues Ridge and Caroline from a mugging.
Eric asks Stephanie to cancel the birthday party. Caroline decides to set Kristen up with her boss.
Bill meets Alex and finds out where she is staying. Caroline tells Stephanie about Ridge pressuring her.
Ridge tries to seduce Margo. Donna apologizes to Rocco. Kristen enjoys her blind date with Chuck.
Katie thanks Rocco for helping her skin clear up. Ridge tries to seduce Brooke and invites her to swim.
Eric asks Thorne the details of his job offer. Bill talks Alex into a plan to humiliate Ridge.
Eric asks Ridge to help him find a way to make Thorne stay. Storm and Mark argue about Donna working too much.
Mark and Donna decide to go out but Donna falls asleep before they leave. Brooke and Caroline go see Ridge.
Mark tells Donna he was an unwanted child. Brooke tells Caroline the truth about what happened.

The Osbournes struggle to come up with a gift for Jack's birthday.

After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another…and is after her.

In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning…but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right…

A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of  things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

Host Will Clinger visits Hot Springs, Arkansas for the annual RUNNING OF THE TUBS – to watch costumed teams race bathtubs filled with water through the downtown; stops in for an historic scrub down & steam at the BUCKSTAFF BATH HOUSE; takes in an astounding collection of 3D advertising art at the POLLACK MUSEUM in AZ; and then attempts to pick the right square at CHICKEN POOP BINGO in Austin, TX.

Host Will Clinger drives the Illinois leg of historic ROUTE 66 to find: the birthplace of the COZY DOG in Springfield; a city hall with a phone booth on its roof in LINCOLN; the land-yacht of itinerant Route 66 artist Bob Waldmire in PONTIAC; a roadside attraction called HENRY’S RABBIT RANCH; and then rides along at the annual bike race/eating contest known as the TOUR DE DONUT in Staunton.

In Chicago, host Will Clinger attends the parody of the IDITAROD - the CHI-DITAROD, where the sled is a shopping cart pulled by people instead of dogs; checks in to the Watergate Hotel’s SCANDAL ROOM in DC; visits the studio of surrealist MICHAEL P PRICE in Arizona; squeezes himself into a DWARF CAR for a drive in Maricopa; and then marvels at an art exhibit made entirely out of PEEPS in Wisconsin.

Host Will Clinger visits McMinnville, Oregon’s UFO FEST to witness the extraterrestrial parade & alien pet contest; examines the MUSEUM OF MENTAL HEALTH in Salem where One Flew Over The Cuckoo’s Nest was filmed; tries not to crash in a jet simulator at the NAVAL FLIGHT ACADEMY in Pensacola; and then marvels at the huge model ships and animated “rock band” made completely out of…TOOTHPICKS!

Host Will Clinger journeys hundreds of feet underground to tour the historic QUEEN COPPER MINE in beautiful Bisbee, Arizona; spends the night at the nearby SHADY DELL retro trailer park; goes nowhere but up at an WHITE MOUNTAIN HOT AIR BALLOONFEST and then tries to dodge ferocious flying carp at the annual central Illinois REDNECK FISHING TOURNAMENT (spoiler alert: he fails).

Host Will Clinger delves into the paranormal legends surrounding EDGAR ALLAN POE and the USS CONSTELLATION in Baltimore; reaches for his wallet at America’s only PURSE MUSEUM in Little Rock; wanders among hundreds of critters at the MIDWEST FUR FEST in Chicago; and then tees off with Sister Cindy at an event called (no kidding) BEAT THE NUN.

Host Will Clinger feels right at home in a roomful of dummies at the VENTRILOQUISTS’ CONVENTION in Kentucky; finds all things feline at the LUCKY CAT MUSEUM in Cincinnat; drives out to CARHENGE - Nebraska’s answer to Stonehenge; and then sees where the bodies are not buried but frozen (in liquid nitrogen) at ALCOR CRYOGENICS in Scottsdale – Open To The Public!

Host Will Clinger spends an entire episode chronicling the annual, KINETIC SCULPTURE RACE in Baltimore – an outrageously challenging competition among two dozen human-powered, amphibious, all-terrain mobile works of art slogging through a 15 mile course of city streets, mud, sand and Baltimore’s inner harbor. All entries are vying for the coveted GRAND MEDIOCRE CHAMPION award.

Host Will Clinger attends the traveling ODDITIES and CURIOSITIES EXPO and encounters some truly bizarre and disturbing exhibits; samples the entertainment and menu at America's only VEGAN STRIP CLUB in Portland; takes in some target practice at MACHINE GUN AMERICA near Orlando; then ascends the UFO WATCHTOWER in Colorado to search the night sky for extraterrestrials.

Samantha explores the history of the Abbey of the Genesee and the popular Monks’ Bread made by the Trappist monks. Samantha visits Chef Melanie Alvarez Santiago, to sample authentic Puerto Rican dishes. Samantha explores the "Grand Canyon of the East" and takes in the sights of Letchworth State Park then joins a community paint day and crafts a bucket at the Genesee Country Village & Museum.

Samantha kicks off her visit to the Garden State in Cape May, and discovers how it played a pivotal role in the fight to end slavery. Samantha visits Beach Plum Farm and talks with a conservationist at the Wetlands Institute about the ground-breaking research they are doing. Other stops include Monmouth Battlefield State Park, Source Farmhouse Brewery and legendary music venue, The Stone Pony.

The Mission Reach project in San Antonio provides walking trails and bike paths and will use portals to connect the San Antonio River to the four historic missions along the river. Samantha tours several of its stops including a visit to Mission Concepcion and learns the history of the river and the impact of this urban ecosystem restoration project.

Samantha joins third-generation deli-man, Ziggy Gruber, in the kitchen to make matzoh ball soup then discusses Ziggy's storied family/deli history, and why his Houston-based Kenny and Ziggy's New York Delicatessen is tops in the nation. Freedmen's Town was originally a community located in the fourth ward of Houston that began in 1865 as the destination for former enslaved people from surrounding plantations in Texas and Louisiana after the Civil War.

Kentucky is synonymous with Bourbon. At Buffalo Trace Distillery, Samantha talks all things bourbon with third-generation employee Freddie Johnson, including the history of bourbon and how it got named. Visiting the Bernheim Arboretum and Research Forest, Samantha learns how German immigrant Isaac W. Bernheim in 1929 used his fortune from bourbon to buy this land and give it back to the people of Kentucky, and how art has always been an important mission of the Forest.

Explore "Olympic City US" at the interactive US Olympic & Paralympic Museum. At the Colorado Wolf and Wildlife Center, Samantha discusses the centers’ mission of providing a home to wolves and foxes. Samantha explores Garden of the Gods and then hangs with the first Latina Brewery Owner in Colorado. Samantha visits Manitou Springs and a shop that repurposes old skis and snowboards into furniture.

Faced with Ezequiel's intentions, Octavia and Marcelina verbally attack Camila. Max proposes and Camila hesitates but agrees to marry him. At a dinner party, Ezequiel gathers his children and Camila will be the special guest of honor.

At the dinner, the main topic will be Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel says that this woman was an opportunist who fell in love with and took advantage of his younger brother, Leoncio. Astrid offends by adding that she was a prostitute, guilty of the war between the two families because of her relationship with Augusto Aragón and also with Leoncio López.

Camila insists on knowing about her family relationship, she thinks she could be Max's cousin. Ezequiel wants to dispel the doubt that she could be his niece, he interrogates Mother Isabel who denies knowing it and also turns to Marcelina who confirms it. Camila protects Chantal, a girl who sells flowers.

Max and Camila in idyllic moments regardless of the outcome of the DNA. They continue their search for Rosa Blanco. Two parcels delivered by a messenger, one for the Lopez Mendez family and the other for the Aragon family, confirm the reappearance of El Doliente.
When they arrive at the house in El Jagüey, Mother Isabel does not let them enter, they meet Henry and presume that he may also be Rosa Blanco's son. Max thinks that something serious
Mother Isabel insists that Rosa Blanco will cause much harm to Camila. Little is known, only that through a phone call she assures that she will return to take revenge.
Marcelina visits Mother Isabel to talk to her about her relationship with Rosa Blanco, who was her best friend and who betrayed her; that is why she wants to prevent her return.

After a phone call from Rosa Blanco to Luciano, Camila, excited, wants to talk to her mother. Captain Torrealba helps her to understand the secrets about the crime. After Sebastian is brutally attacked, Ezequiel wants to avenge her with Fernando, an Aragon.
